FC Completion Report macro -- consolidated change set.
Validated against the real export FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx (7,434 rows,
June 2026) and against the team's manually produced report for the same month.

GLOBAL RULES
- Every change goes into BOTH the relevant *.bas file AND the mirrored copy in
  FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt.
- Keep FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt clean ASCII: "--" for dashes, no smart quotes,
  no Unicode. Build any dash characters with ChrW(), never paste them literally.
- Some items below may already be applied from an earlier session. Verify each
  before editing; if already correct, say so and move on rather than reapplying.
- Read CLAUDE.md and docs/VBA_Code_Progress.md before starting.

RECONCILIATION CONTEXT -- read before touching BuildOutput
The manual report for June 2026 gives EM = 6,035 and EL = 627. Testing every
combination of candidate rules against the real export:

  macro as it stands (POC gate on)      EM 6,025   EL    12
  POC gate removed                      EM 6,025   EL   578
  + voided/deleted kept in denominator  EM 6,033   EL   626
  + shopper rows kept                   EM 6,033   EL   627
  manual report                         EM 6,035   EL   627

The file holds only 6,660 unique encounter numbers, 6,033 of them Emergency, so
6,035 EM is impossible under any dedup rule -- the manual sheet contains 2 residual
duplicate rows its combing step missed. Do NOT try to reproduce 6,035.

================================================================
PART 1 -- DATA-VALUE FIXES (verify, apply if missing)
================================================================

1.1  BuildOutput.bas -- ADM_ELECTIVE is "Elective Inpatient" but the export writes
     "Elective inpa". With the long form, all 578 elective encounters fail both the
     EM and EL test and land in the section-0 "neither" bucket. Change the constant
     to "Elective inpa" and match on normalised prefix "ELECTIVE INPA" so the full
     word also matches if eFC changes. PART 2 is useless without this.

1.2  BuildOutput.bas TryParseDMYDate -- the export is M/D/Y ("6/15/2026"), but the
     function reads parts(0) as day and parts(1) as month. DateSerial(2026,15,6)
     silently rolls over to March 2027, so GetReportPeriodLabel is wrong on every
     run. Parse as M/D/Y, reject month > 12 and day > 31, rename to TryParseMDYDate.

1.3  FilterFileB.bas (~line 335) -- the export misspells the header as
     "Accomodation Code" (one m). FindColByHeader("Accommodation Code") returns 0
     and EDVW flagging is silently skipped. Try both spellings.

1.4  Helpers.bas CreateConfigSheet -- prefill the "NCID EL Point of Care" list
     (column D) with these ten confirmed values, still user-editable:
       TTSH NCID WARD 3E ICU
       TTSH NCID WARD 6F (ISO)
       TTSH NCID WARD 7E (NEP)
       TTSH NCID WARD 7F (ISO)
       TTSH NCID WARD 8E (NEP)
       TTSH NCID WARD 8F (ISO)
       TTSH NCID WARD 11E (NEP)
       TTSH NCID WARD 11F (COHORT)
       TTSH NCID WARD 12E (COHORT)
       TTSH NCID WARD 14F (COHORT)

================================================================
PART 2 -- REVERSIONS
================================================================

2.1  REVERT A -- remove the NCID Point of Care gate on the EL sheet.
     BuildOutput.bas currently requires an Elective row's Point Of Care to be in
     the Config NCID list before it goes to EL. That is wrong: EL is ALL elective
     inpatient encounters. Q1 as originally confirmed was correct.
       - An encounter goes to EL on Admission Type alone.
       - Delete the empty-list MsgBox, the "EL statistics skipped" branch, and the
         elSkippedCount reporting. EL is now never skipped.
       - Do NOT delete the Config list or its loader -- it is reused in PART 3.

2.2  REVERT B -- keep Voided/Deleted-only encounters IN the denominator.
     The manual report includes them: 8 in EM, 48 in EL, 56 total. Q4 as confirmed,
     and the guide's "NOT TO BE INCLUDED AS DENOMINATOR" note, both disagree with
     actual practice. Practice wins for now.
       - BuildOutput.bas (~line 755): priority 99 rows are no longer excluded from
         encCt. They count toward the denominator and toward not-completed.
       - Give them their own Summary row, "Voided/Deleted only", under the
         "Not completed (total)" subtotal alongside "Draft only". Uncoloured.
       - Keep voidedOnlyCount and keep reporting it, but it is now informational.
         Reword every place that claims these were excluded: Summary footnote,
         Methodology sheet, MainMacro success MsgBox.

2.3  DO NOT REVERT the priority 98 / 99 split. It stays exactly as is:
     99 = Voided/Deleted only, matched on "VOID"/"DELET" substrings;
     98 = unrecognised or blank status. Both now sit in the denominator, but they
     must remain separately counted and separately reported.

2.4  KEEP deleting Shopper-mode rows, but report the consequence.
     Exactly one encounter in this export has a Shopper enquiry as its only form.
     The manual report counts it; we should not, because a price enquiry is not a
     counselling. Keep FilterFCMode's exact-match behaviour -- do NOT switch to a
     substring match, since "Financial Counselling - AH (Shopper)" would then be
     wrongly included. Add a count of encounters that vanish entirely because every
     row was dropped by the FC Mode filter, and print it on the Summary and
     Methodology sheets: "N encounter(s) excluded -- only form was a Shopper enquiry
     or other non-FC mode." This makes the 1-encounter gap from the manual report
     explainable rather than mysterious.

================================================================
PART 3 -- OUTPUT ADDITIONS
================================================================

3.1  NCID Point of Care becomes a breakdown, not a gate.
       - Add an informational "NCID Ward" (Yes/No) column to the EL sheet.
       - Add a sub-block under the EL summary: "of which NCID wards" -- encounter
         count and completion bands for that subset only.
       - Warn on the Summary if any Point Of Care value containing "NCID" is not
         in the Config list, so a new ward is never silently missed.

3.2  Small-denominator guard. In WriteSummaryBlock, when a block's denominator is
     below 30, show counts only, suppress the % column, and print "n too small for
     percentages". The NCID subset is n=12 for June 2026 and percentages on twelve
     cases will be misread at a department meeting.

3.3  Reconciliation waterfall on the Summary sheet. This is what lets the team
     verify the macro against a manual run. One block, each line a count:
       rows in File A as loaded
       less rows dropped by FC Mode filter
       less rows dropped by Cancelled filter
       unique encounter numbers
       less duplicate rows removed by dedup  (and how many encounters had duplicates)
       encounters carried forward
       of which Voided/Deleted only           (informational, still counted)
       of which unrecognised status           (informational, still counted)
       less encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter
       plus missed FC from File B or manual entry
       = DENOMINATOR
     Then the EM / EL / neither split, which must sum to the encounter count.
     Include a visible check row that flags any point where the arithmetic fails
     to balance.

================================================================
PART 4 -- STAFF ROSTER
================================================================

Context: the export has no staff department column -- only display names in
"FC Created By" and "Latest CCF Creation User". The Config roster is the only
name-to-team bridge, and it gates the "who closed the CCF" breakdown, all four
numerator indicators, the Inflight duplicate exception, and the EM/EL "looks wrong"
flag. It ships empty, so GetStaffTeam returns "Others" for everyone and the macro
silently produces a Summary claiming 100% of CCFs were closed by "Others" with all
four indicators at zero. That plausible-looking wrong output is the problem.
The export has 152 distinct staff names, but the top 10 creators cover 83.6% of rows
and the top 30 cover 92.5%. Design for partial completion.

4.1  Roster coverage guard. Add a function measuring the percentage of encounters
     whose resolved CCF closer (Latest CCF Creation User, falling back to FC Created
     By per Q7) maps to a named team rather than "Others". Call it in MainMacro after
     File A cleaning, before BuildOutputWorkbook.
       - Coverage 0%: MsgBox vbYesNo explaining the roster is empty or matches
         nothing, that team attribution and all four indicators will be unavailable,
         asking whether to continue with completion statistics only. If No, abort
         cleanly. If Yes, set a flag so BuildOutput SUPPRESSES the "Who Closed the
         CCF" and "FC Activity Detail" blocks entirely -- do not print rows of zeros
         -- and stamps the Summary and Methodology sheets with why they are missing.
       - Coverage below 70%: proceed, MsgBox the figure, and list the unmatched staff
         names on the Summary in descending row-count order with their counts, so the
         user can see which names to add for the biggest gain.
       - Coverage 70% or above: proceed silently, still list unmatched names on the
         existing Staff Roster Check sheet.

4.2  Harden GetStaffTeam. Run both the roster key and the lookup name through
     NormalizeDashesAndSpaces plus whitespace collapsing before comparing, so a
     trailing or doubled space in eFC does not silently dump someone into "Others".
     Real names include apostrophes, commas and inconsistent capitalisation
     (Lin Shen'An, Yus' Nur Tiara Binte Yusni, LIM YONG CHIEW, DESMOND) -- all must
     match correctly. vbTextCompare already covers case.

4.3  SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare -- new public sub in Helpers.bas, run via Alt+F8.
     A one-off bootstrap so the user never faces a blank roster. Prompts for an FC
     Summary Report export via Application.FileDialog, tallies Point Of Care per
     staff name across BOTH "FC Created By" and "Latest CCF Creation User", writes
     suggestions to the Config sheet.
     Suggested team from dominant Point Of Care:
         "TTSH EMERGENCY"                       -> ED/EDFC
         "TTSH Virtual Ward", "TTSH@HOME ..."   -> Inflight
         contains "NCID"                        -> NCID AO
         starts with "ICH WARD"                 -> ICH PSO
         anything else                          -> Others
     Columns, sorted by row count DESCENDING so the names that matter are on top:
     Staff Name | Rows | Dominant Point Of Care | % Dominant | Suggested Team |
     Confidence.
       - Confidence = "LOW -- please confirm" when % dominant is under 50, else "OK".
         In the real data Sison Ysabelle Maria Carissa Ravalo is 43% Virtual Ward and
         Norhayati Binte Dol is spread across several ICH wards -- both must come out
         flagged LOW.
       - CRITICAL: never overwrite a team the user has already entered. Write
         suggestions to their own columns and fill only blank Team cells. Note in the
         header that suggestions are a starting point and the team leads' own staff
         lists are authoritative.
       - Summary MsgBox: names analysed, count suggested per team, count flagged LOW.

4.4  Roster export / import, two public subs in Helpers.bas. The report rotates
     monthly between team leads; if each has their own workbook copy, rosters drift
     and month-over-month figures stop being comparable for invisible reasons.
       - ExportStaffRoster: writes Staff Name, Team to CSV via a SaveAs FileDialog.
       - ImportStaffRoster: reads such a CSV via an Open FileDialog, confirms, then
         replaces the roster; reports entries loaded and malformed rows skipped.
       - Quote fields on export and parse quoted fields on import, so
         "LIM YONG CHIEW, DESMOND" survives a round trip.

================================================================
PART 5 -- VALIDATION TARGET
================================================================

For FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx with an empty staff roster, no File B and
missed count 0, the macro must produce:

    rows loaded                     7,434
    after FC Mode filter            7,432   (2 Shopper rows dropped)
    after Cancelled filter          7,432   (no Cancelled rows this month)
    unique encounters               6,659
    duplicate groups                  613   (773 rows removed)
    of which Voided/Deleted only       56   (8 EM, 48 EL) -- counted, not excluded
    of which unrecognised status         0
    encounters lost to mode filter       1   (Shopper-only)
    DENOMINATOR                     6,659
    EM                              6,033
    EL                                626
    EL of which NCID wards             12

The difference from the manual report (EM 6,035 / EL 627) is fully explained by
+1 EL shopper-only encounter we deliberately exclude and +2 EM residual duplicates
the manual process missed. State this on the Methodology sheet.

================================================================
PART 6 -- AFTERWARDS
================================================================

- Update docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md: Section 2 step 8,
  Section 2 step 9, Section 5A. Record that Q1 was revisited and its original
  answer (Admission Type only) was correct, and that Q4 is contradicted by actual
  practice and is now an open question for the team.
- Update CLAUDE.md: the outstanding-blanks list can close item 1 (headers
  confirmed) and item 6 (NCID POC values confirmed). Its priority table must match
  the code.
- Update docs/VBA_Code_Progress.md with what changed per module; reset compile
  status to "needs user re-compile".
- grep to confirm .bas files and FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt are in sync, with no
  duplicate Sub/Function names or dangling references.
- Output a summary listing each file edited and the exact sections changed.
- Do not commit.

## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.

## claude.ai Supabase
Here are guidelines for using Supabase tools effectively:

- Before making schema changes, use `list_tables` to understand the existing structure
- When debugging issues, start with `get_logs` and `get_advisors` before making changes
- Use `get_project_url` and `get_publishable_api_key` when helping users configure client-side integrations

If you have access to a local development environment with a filesystem and shell:
- Install the Supabase agent skill for critical development and security guidance: `npx skills add supabase/agent-skills` (https://supabase.com/docs/guides/getting-started/ai-skills.md)
- Use the Supabase CLI (`supabase`) for local development workflows such as starting a local stack, managing migrations, and running edge functions locally (https://supabase.com/docs/guides/local-development.md)
- Prefer local development and testing before applying changes to a remote project

If you are running in a web-only or remote environment without filesystem or shell access:
- Rely on the MCP tools directly for all Supabase interactions
- Use `apply_migration` carefully, as changes go directly to the remote project

## plugin:context7:context7
Use this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service — even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. This includes API syntax, configuration, version migration, library-specific debugging, setup instructions, and CLI tool usage. Use even when you think you know the answer — your training data may not reflect recent changes. Prefer this over web search for library docs.

Do not use for: refactoring, writing scripts from scratch, debugging business logic, code review, or general programming concepts.

Base directory for this skill: C:\Users\lutfi\.claude\plugins\cache\claude-plugins-official\superpowers\6.2.0\skills\writing-plans

# Writing Plans

## Overview

Write comprehensive implementation plans assuming the engineer has zero context for our codebase and questionable taste. Document everything they need to know: which files to touch for each task, code, testing, docs they might need to check, how to test it. Give them the whole plan as bite-sized tasks. DRY. YAGNI. TDD. Frequent commits.

Assume they are a skilled developer, but know almost nothing about our toolset or problem domain. Assume they don't know good test design very well.

**Announce at start:** "I'm using the writing-plans skill to create the implementation plan."

**Context:** If working in an isolated worktree, it should have been created via the `superpowers:using-git-worktrees` skill at execution time.

**Save plans to:** `docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<feature-name>.md`
- (User preferences for plan location override this default)

## Scope Check

If the spec covers multiple independent subsystems, it should have been broken into sub-project specs during brainstorming. If it wasn't, suggest breaking this into separate plans — one per subsystem. Each plan should produce working, testable software on its own.

## File Structure

Before defining tasks, map out which files will be created or modified and what each one is responsible for. This is where decomposition decisions get locked in.

- Design units with clear boundaries and well-defined interfaces. Each file should have one clear responsibility.
- You reason best about code you can hold in context at once, and your edits are more reliable when files are focused. Prefer smaller, focused files over large ones that do too much.
- Files that change together should live together. Split by responsibility, not by technical layer.
- In existing codebases, follow established patterns. If the codebase uses large files, don't unilaterally restructure - but if a file you're modifying has grown unwieldy, including a split in the plan is reasonable.

This structure informs the task decomposition. Each task should produce self-contained changes that make sense independently.

## Task Right-Sizing

A task is the smallest unit that carries its own test cycle and is worth a
fresh reviewer's gate. When drawing task boundaries: fold setup,
configuration, scaffolding, and documentation steps into the task whose
deliverable needs them; split only where a reviewer could meaningfully
reject one task while approving its neighbor. Each task ends with an
independently testable deliverable.

## Bite-Sized Task Granularity

**Each step is one action (2-5 minutes):**
- "Write the failing test" - step
- "Run it to make sure it fails" - step
- "Implement the minimal code to make the test pass" - step
- "Run the tests and make sure they pass" - step
- "Commit" - step

## Plan Document Header

**Every plan MUST start with this header:**

```markdown
# [Feature Name] Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** [One sentence describing what this builds]

**Architecture:** [2-3 sentences about approach]

**Tech Stack:** [Key technologies/libraries]

## Global Constraints

[The spec's project-wide requirements — version floors, dependency limits,
naming and copy rules, platform requirements — one line each, with exact
values copied verbatim from the spec. Every task's requirements implicitly
include this section.]

---
```

## Task Structure

````markdown
### Task N: [Component Name]

**Files:**
- Create: `exact/path/to/file.py`
- Modify: `exact/path/to/existing.py:123-145`
- Test: `tests/exact/path/to/test.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: [what this task uses from earlier tasks — exact signatures]
- Produces: [what later tasks rely on — exact function names, parameter
  and return types. A task's implementer sees only their own task; this
  block is how they learn the names and types neighboring tasks use.]

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```python
def test_specific_behavior():
    result = function(input)
    assert result == expected
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run test to verify it fails**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: FAIL with "function not defined"

- [ ] **Step 3: Write minimal implementation**

```python
def function(input):
    return expected
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run test to verify it passes**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: PASS

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**

```bash
git add tests/path/test.py src/path/file.py
git commit -m "feat: add specific feature"
```
````

## No Placeholders

Every step must contain the actual content an engineer needs. These are **plan failures** — never write them:
- "TBD", "TODO", "implement later", "fill in details"
- "Add appropriate error handling" / "add validation" / "handle edge cases"
- "Write tests for the above" (without actual test code)
- "Similar to Task N" (repeat the code — the engineer may be reading tasks out of order)
- Steps that describe what to do without showing how (code blocks required for code steps)
- References to types, functions, or methods not defined in any task

## Self-Review

After writing the complete plan, look at the spec with fresh eyes and check the plan against it. This is a checklist you run yourself — not a subagent dispatch.

**1. Spec coverage:** Skim each section/requirement in the spec. Can you point to a task that implements it? List any gaps.

**2. Placeholder scan:** Search your plan for red flags — any of the patterns from the "No Placeholders" section above. Fix them.

**3. Type consistency:** Do the types, method signatures, and property names you used in later tasks match what you defined in earlier tasks? A function called `clearLayers()` in Task 3 but `clearFullLayers()` in Task 7 is a bug.

If you find issues, fix them inline. No need to re-review — just fix and move on. If you find a spec requirement with no task, add the task.

## Execution Handoff

After saving the plan, offer execution choice:

**"Plan complete and saved to `docs/superpowers/plans/<filename>.md`. Two execution options:**

**1. Subagent-Driven (recommended)** - I dispatch a fresh subagent per task, review between tasks, fast iteration

**2. Inline Execution** - Execute tasks in this session using executing-plans, batch execution with checkpoints

**Which approach?"**

**If Subagent-Driven chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development
- Fresh subagent per task + two-stage review

**If Inline Execution chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:executing-plans
- Batch execution with checkpoints for review

The user's message is already an exhaustive, line-by-line specification (exact files, exact values, exact validation targets) — writing a second formal plan document would just duplicate it without adding value, and their closing instructions explicitly ask for direct edits + a summary, not a plan handoff. I'll skip the formal plan doc and go straight to implementation, tracking the many sub-tasks with TaskCreate. Let me first look at the current state of the relevant files.

This tracks what's been implemented so far vs. what's still waiting on
answers from colleagues (see `docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md`
and the "Outstanding blanks" list in `CLAUDE.md`).

Module files live in the project root (`*.bas`) and are mirrored into

deliverable, regenerated via `regen_modules.ps1`).

FilterFileB, DeduplicateEncounters, BuildOutput, MainMacro, FilePickerForm,
ProgressForm) -- **needs user re-compile** after the 2026-07-29 conflict
resolution (see "2026-07-29 conflict resolution" section below -- every
module except ProgressForm.bas changed). Previous modules compiled cleanly
as of 2026-06-10; not re-verified since.

---

## Done

### Helpers.bas
- `FindColByHeader`, `NormHeader` -- header-based column lookup, copied
  verbatim from the MFC macro.
- `FindEncounterCol` -- tries "Encounter Number" (File A) then "Encounter No"

  and `INFLIGHT_MISSED` (File B).
- `IsMissedFCColumnBlank` -- detects the File B "Missed FC column entirely
  blank" workaround case from CLAUDE.md.
- `CreateConfigSheet` / `LoadStaffRoster` / `GetStaffTeam` -- builds and reads
  a "Staff Name -> Team" roster table on a `Config` sheet. Teams: ED/EDFC,
  Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others (default for anyone not
  listed).

### ProgressForm.bas
Reused as-is from the MFC macro, caption updated to "FC Completion Report --
Generating".

### FilePickerForm.bas
2-slot dashboard (File A: FC Summary Report, File B: Inflight Missed FC
Report) -- Browse/status per slot, duplicate-file check, Missed-FC-blank
warning, Generate enabled only when both slots are valid.

**Note:** status indicators use plain ASCII ("Valid" / "Invalid" / "O" / "X
Same file") instead of the `(check)/(cross)/(circle)/(warning)` symbols used
in the MFC form. CLAUDE.md requires `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` to stay in
clean ASCII (the MFC project has had repeated Unicode-corruption issues
needing `fix_qmarks.ps1`-style cleanup) -- using ASCII from the start avoids
that for this project. Flag if you'd prefer the Unicode symbols anyway.

### FilterFileA.bas (Steps 1-2)
- `FilterFCMode` -- keep only "Financial Counselling - AH" /
  "Financial Counselling - Downtime".
- `DeleteCancelledAdmissions` -- drop Admission Status = "Cancelled".

### FilterFileB.bas (Steps 1-4 of the process flow doc)
- `FilterFCModeIfPresent` -- no-op if File B has no "FC Mode" column

- `KeepOnlyMissedFC` -- keep only Missed FC = "Yes".
- `DeleteCancelledOrPlanned` -- drop Admission Status = "Cancelled"/"Planned".
- `FlagEDVWDischarges` -- adds an informational "EDVW Discharge" column
  (Point Of Care = "TTSH Virtual Ward" + Accommodation Code = "EDVW"). Rows
  are NOT removed -- this is a label only, per the process flow doc's current
  proposal for Q5.

### DeduplicateEncounters.bas (Steps 3, 5-8)
- `GetFCStatusPriority` -- the 10-level priority table from the process flow
  doc (Q2).
- `AddPriorityColumn` -- writes a "PRIORITISE" column.
- `MarkDuplicateEncounters` -- highlights duplicate Encounter Numbers in red
  (visual aid).
- `ResolveDuplicateEncounters` -- automatically picks one row per Encounter
  Number (lowest priority wins, tie-break by larger FC ID), applies the
  Inflight-creator exception (Q3) via the Config roster, deletes the rest, and
  counts Voided/Deleted-only encounters (Q4) for the final report.

**Note (2026-06-18):** Q2-Q4 (and all other process flow questions) are now
confirmed -- see "Process flow confirmation" section below. The Inflight
exception is driven entirely by the `Config` roster; with an empty roster
`GetStaffTeam` returns "Others" for everyone, so the exception is inert until
real staff names are filled in.

---

## Process flow confirmation (2026-06-18)

All 8 questions from `docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md`
have been confirmed by the user. The process flow doc is now the authoritative
spec -- its rules should be implemented as written.

## 2026-07-29 conflict resolution

Resolved five spec conflicts between "Guide to monthly processing of report
3.docx" (the authoritative process guide) and
`docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md`, which had silently
diverged from the guide by the time Q1-Q8 were confirmed 2026-06-18. Also

**Decision 1 -- EM/EL split now requires Point of Care (Q1 revised).**

41	Private Function TryParseDMYDate(dateText As String, ByRef result As Date) As Boolean
42	    Dim datePart As String
43	    Dim spacePos As Long
44	    spacePos = InStr(dateText, " ")
45	    If spacePos > 0 Then
46	        datePart = Trim(Left(dateText, spacePos - 1))
47	    Else
48	        datePart = Trim(dateText)
49	    End If
50	
51	    Dim parts() As String
52	    parts = Split(datePart, "/")
53	    If UBound(parts) <> 2 Then
54	        TryParseDMYDate = False
55	        Exit Function
56	    End If
57	    If Not IsNumeric(parts(0)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(1)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(2)) Then
58	        TryParseDMYDate = False
59	        Exit Function
60	    End If
61	
62	    Dim d As Long, m As Long, y As Long
63	    d = CLng(parts(0)): m = CLng(parts(1)): y = CLng(parts(2))
64	    If y < 100 Then y = y + 2000
65	
66	    On Error GoTo Fail
67	    result = DateSerial(y, m, d)
68	    TryParseDMYDate = True
69	    Exit Function
70	Fail:

72	End Function

75	    Dim admDateCol As Long

89

94	    For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)

96	        If TryParseDMYDate(txt, parsed) Then
97	            key = Year(parsed) & "-" & Month(parsed)
98	            If counts.Exists(key) Then counts(key) = counts(key) + 1 Else counts(key) = 1
99	        End If

103

105	    Dim k As Variant

153	' ---- Write File A rows to a sheet, filtered by pre-computed section code -
154	
155	' secArr(i) holds the section code (SEC_EM / SEC_EL / 0) for fullData row i,
156	' computed once in BuildOutputWorkbook's main pass. Using a pre-computed array
157	' (rather than re-deriving from Admission Type text, as the old version did)
158	' is what lets the EL sheet honour the NCID Point of Care gate (Decision 1) --
159	' an Elective Inpatient row whose Point of Care isn't in the configured list
160	' gets secArr(i) = 0 and is excluded from both EM and EL.
161	Private Function WriteFilteredFileASheet(ws As Worksheet, fullData As Variant, _
162	        totalRows As Long, outCols As Long, secArr() As Long, targetSec As Long) As Long
163	
164	    Dim matchCount As Long, i As Long, j As Long
165	    For i = 2 To totalRows
166	        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then matchCount = matchCount + 1
167	    Next i
168	
169	    For j = 1 To outCols
170	        ws.Cells(1, j).Value = fullData(1, j)
171	    Next j
172	
173	    If matchCount = 0 Then
174	        FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
175	        ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
176	        WriteFilteredFileASheet = 0
177	        Exit Function
178	    End If
179	
180	    Dim outArr() As Variant
181	    ReDim outArr(1 To matchCount, 1 To outCols)
182	    Dim outRow As Long
183	    For i = 2 To totalRows
184	        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then
185	            outRow = outRow + 1
186	            For j = 1 To outCols
187	                outArr(outRow, j) = fullData(i, j)
188	            Next j
189	        End If
190	    Next i
191	
192	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + matchCount, outCols)).Value = outArr
193	    FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
194	    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
195	    WriteFilteredFileASheet = matchCount
196	End Function

796

Attribute VB_Name = "BuildOutput"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' BuildOutput.bas
'
' Builds the FC Completion Report output workbook:
'   - EM sheet (Emergency encounters from File A)
'   - EL sheet (Elective Inpatient encounters from File A, gated on the
'     Config "NCID EL Point of Care" list -- Decision 1, 2026-07-29)
'   - Missed FC sheet (File B data) -- SKIPPED when File B was not provided
'   - Summary sheet (five-band colour-coded completion + team breakdown --
'     Decision 3)
'   - Methodology sheet (plain-language rule explanation)
'   - Staff Roster Check sheet (roster coverage check)
'
' 2026-07-29 conflict resolution against "Guide to monthly processing of
' report 3.docx" changed several rules here -- see Decisions 1, 2, 3, 5 in
' the commit/PR description and docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md.
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_EM As String = "EM"
Public Const SHEET_EL As String = "EL"
Public Const SHEET_MISSED_FC As String = "Missed FC"
Public Const SHEET_SUMMARY As String = "Summary"
Public Const SHEET_METHODOLOGY As String = "Methodology"
Public Const SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK As String = "Staff Roster Check"

Private Const ADM_EMERGENCY As String = "Emergency"
Private Const ADM_ELECTIVE  As String = "Elective Inpatient"

' Section codes used in secArr() (see BuildOutputWorkbook):
'   1 = EM (Emergency)
'   2 = EL (Elective Inpatient, Point of Care matched the NCID list)
'   0 = neither -- excluded from both sheets, reported separately
Private Const SEC_EM As Long = 1
Private Const SEC_EL As Long = 2

' ---- Date parsing (eFC export format) ------------------------------------

Private Function TryParseDMYDate(dateText As String, ByRef result As Date) As Boolean
    Dim datePart As String
    Dim spacePos As Long
    spacePos = InStr(dateText, " ")
    If spacePos > 0 Then
        datePart = Trim(Left(dateText, spacePos - 1))
    Else
        datePart = Trim(dateText)
    End If

    Dim parts() As String
    parts = Split(datePart, "/")
    If UBound(parts) <> 2 Then
        TryParseDMYDate = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Not IsNumeric(parts(0)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(1)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(2)) Then
        TryParseDMYDate = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim d As Long, m As Long, y As Long
    d = CLng(parts(0)): m = CLng(parts(1)): y = CLng(parts(2))
    If y < 100 Then y = y + 2000

    On Error GoTo Fail
    result = DateSerial(y, m, d)
    TryParseDMYDate = True
    Exit Function
Fail:
    TryParseDMYDate = False
End Function

Public Function GetReportPeriodLabel(fileAws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim admDateCol As Long
    admDateCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Date")
    If admDateCol = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    If encCol = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim data As Variant
    data = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, admDateCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, admDateCol)).Value

    Dim counts As Object
    Set counts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    Dim i As Long, txt As String, parsed As Date, key As String
    For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
        If lastRow = 2 Then txt = CStr(data) Else txt = CStr(data(i, 1))
        If TryParseDMYDate(txt, parsed) Then
            key = Year(parsed) & "-" & Month(parsed)
            If counts.Exists(key) Then counts(key) = counts(key) + 1 Else counts(key) = 1
        End If
    Next i

    If counts.Count = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim bestKey As String, bestCount As Long
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In counts.Keys
        If counts(k) > bestCount Then bestCount = counts(k): bestKey = CStr(k)
    Next k

    Dim pts() As String
    pts = Split(bestKey, "-")
    GetReportPeriodLabel = MonthName(CLng(pts(1)), False) & CStr(CLng(pts(0)))
End Function

' ---- Small helpers -------------------------------------------------------

Private Sub InitTeamCounts(d As Object)
    d.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    d(TEAM_ED_EDFC) = 0
    d(TEAM_INFLIGHT) = 0
    d(TEAM_NCID_AO) = 0
    d(TEAM_ICH_PSO) = 0
    d(TEAM_ADMIN) = 0
    d(TEAM_OTHERS) = 0
End Sub

Private Function AddSheet(wb As Workbook, sheetName As String) As Worksheet
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))
    ws.Name = sheetName
    Set AddSheet = ws
End Function

Private Sub FormatHeaderRow(ws As Worksheet, lastCol As Long)
    With ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(1, lastCol))
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 73, 125)
        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Rows(1).AutoFilter
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Private Function SafePct(num As Long, denom As Long) As Double
    If denom > 0 Then SafePct = num / denom Else SafePct = 0
End Function

Private Function CellStr(v As Variant) As String
    CellStr = Trim(CStr(v))
End Function

' ---- Write File A rows to a sheet, filtered by pre-computed section code -

' secArr(i) holds the section code (SEC_EM / SEC_EL / 0) for fullData row i,
' computed once in BuildOutputWorkbook's main pass. Using a pre-computed array
' (rather than re-deriving from Admission Type text, as the old version did)
' is what lets the EL sheet honour the NCID Point of Care gate (Decision 1) --
' an Elective Inpatient row whose Point of Care isn't in the configured list
' gets secArr(i) = 0 and is excluded from both EM and EL.
Private Function WriteFilteredFileASheet(ws As Worksheet, fullData As Variant, _
        totalRows As Long, outCols As Long, secArr() As Long, targetSec As Long) As Long

    Dim matchCount As Long, i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To totalRows
        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then matchCount = matchCount + 1
    Next i

    For j = 1 To outCols
        ws.Cells(1, j).Value = fullData(1, j)
    Next j

    If matchCount = 0 Then
        FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
        ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
        WriteFilteredFileASheet = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim outArr() As Variant
    ReDim outArr(1 To matchCount, 1 To outCols)
    Dim outRow As Long
    For i = 2 To totalRows
        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To outCols
                outArr(outRow, j) = fullData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + matchCount, outCols)).Value = outArr
    FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
    WriteFilteredFileASheet = matchCount
End Function

' ---- Highlight rows where Latest CCF Creation User was blank (Q7) --------

Private Sub HighlightCCFFallbackRows(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim latestCol As Long, closerCol As Long, encCol As Long
    latestCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    closerCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "CCF Closed By")
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If latestCol = 0 Or closerCol = 0 Or encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim rng As Range
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If CellStr(ws.Cells(i, latestCol).Value) = "" And _
           CellStr(ws.Cells(i, closerCol).Value) <> "" Then
            If rng Is Nothing Then
                Set rng = ws.Cells(i, closerCol)
            Else
                Set rng = Union(rng, ws.Cells(i, closerCol))
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If Not rng Is Nothing Then rng.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 153)
End Sub

' ---- Write Missed FC sheet (File B data as-is) ---------------------------

Private Sub WriteMissedFCSheet(ws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet)
    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "No encounter column found in File B."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    lastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    lastCol = fileBws.Cells(1, fileBws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    If lastRow < 1 Or lastCol < 1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim data As Variant
    data = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(1, 1), fileBws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value = data
    FormatHeaderRow ws, lastCol
    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
End Sub

' ---- Summary sheet -------------------------------------------------------

' Decision 3 (2026-07-29 conflict resolution): five colour bands instead of
' four, with Drafts/unrecognised (priority 98) split out into their own
' White/none band rather than folded into Red. A "Not completed (total)"
' subtotal (Orange + Draft + Missed) keeps the old single headline figure
' available. The colour NAMES shift meaning vs. the pre-2026-07-29 code: what
' was "Light Green" is now "Pink" (priority 3), and what was "Orange" is now
' "Light Green" (priority 4-5) -- parameter names below match the NEW bands.
Private Sub WriteSummaryBlock(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, _
        title As String, encCount As Long, missedCount As Long, missedSourceLabel As String, _
        greenCt As Long, pinkCt As Long, ltGreenCt As Long, orangeCt As Long, draftCt As Long, _
        teamD As Object, blankCCFCt As Long, _
        edInit As Long, edFull As Long, inflFull As Long, ncidFull As Long)

    Dim denom As Long
    denom = encCount + missedCount

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = title
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Denominator: " & denom & " encounters"
    If missedCount > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = ws.Cells(r, 1).Value & _
            " (" & encCount & " from FC Summary + " & missedCount & " missed FC, source: " & _
            missedSourceLabel & ")"
    End If
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Completion status table (five colour bands) ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Completion Status"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ' Green (priority 1-2)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completed with written acknowledgement"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = greenCt
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(greenCt, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(146, 208, 80)
    r = r + 1

    ' Pink (priority 3)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF explained but not signed"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = pinkCt
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(pinkCt, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 203)
    r = r + 1

    ' Light Green (priority 4-5)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Attempted, no further follow-up"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = ltGreenCt
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(ltGreenCt, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(198, 239, 206)
    r = r + 1

    ' Orange (priority 6)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC not completed"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = orangeCt
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(orangeCt, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 0)
    r = r + 1

    ' White/none (priority 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, unrecognised statuses)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Draft only -- no FC outcome"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = draftCt
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(draftCt, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
    r = r + 1

    ' Grey (File B / manual entry -- missed FC, no FC ID ever created)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC -- no FC ID created"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(missedCount, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(217, 217, 217)
    r = r + 1

    ' Not completed (total) -- Orange + Draft + Missed. The overall
    ' completion % is unchanged by splitting Draft out into its own row;
    ' this subtotal keeps the single headline "not completed" figure.
    Dim notCompletedTotal As Long
    notCompletedTotal = orangeCt + draftCt + missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Not completed (total)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = notCompletedTotal
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Italic = True
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(notCompletedTotal, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Font.Italic = True
    r = r + 1

    ' Total row -- visible sanity check that the bands sum to the denominator.
    Dim bandSum As Long
    bandSum = greenCt + pinkCt + ltGreenCt + orangeCt + draftCt + missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bandSum
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(bandSum, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    If bandSum <> denom Then
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "MISMATCH: bands sum to " & bandSum & " but denominator is " & _
            denom & " -- report this, there is a bug in the counting logic."
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
    End If
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Who closed the CCF ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Who Closed the CCF"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim teams As Variant
    teams = Array(TEAM_ED_EDFC, TEAM_INFLIGHT, TEAM_NCID_AO, _
                  TEAM_ICH_PSO, TEAM_ADMIN, TEAM_OTHERS)
    Dim t As Long
    For t = LBound(teams) To UBound(teams)
        Dim tName As String
        tName = CStr(teams(t))
        Dim tCount As Long
        tCount = 0
        If teamD.Exists(tName) Then tCount = teamD(tName)
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = tName
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = tCount
        ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(tCount, denom)
        ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
        r = r + 1
    Next t

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF not generated (Missed FC)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = SafePct(missedCount, denom)
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = denom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = 1
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True

    If blankCCFCt > 0 Then
        r = r + 1
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  (" & blankCCFCt & _
            " encounter(s) had blank 'Latest CCF Creation User' -- fell back to 'FC Created By')"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- FC Activity Detail ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Activity Detail"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC created by EDFC (initial -- FC Created By)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = edInit
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by EDFC (Latest CCF Creation User)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = edFull
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by Inflight"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = inflFull
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by NCID AO"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = ncidFull
    r = r + 3
End Sub

Private Sub WriteSummarySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, _
        elComputed As Boolean, elSkippedCount As Long, elPocExcluded As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedFCSourceLabel As String, _
        emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, emOrange As Long, emDraft As Long, _
        elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long, elOrange As Long, elDraft As Long, _
        emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object, _
        emBlankCCF As Long, elBlankCCF As Long, _
        emEdInit As Long, emEdFull As Long, emInflFull As Long, emNcidFull As Long, _
        elEdInit As Long, elEdFull As Long, elInflFull As Long, elNcidFull As Long, _
        voidedTotal As Long, otherEncCount As Long, missedOther As Long, _
        unrecognisedStatuses As Object, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completion Report -- " & reportLabel
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- EM block (always computed) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "EMERGENCY (EM) ADMISSIONS", _
        emEnc, missedEM, missedFCSourceLabel, emGreen, emPink, emLtGreen, emOrange, emDraft, _
        emTeams, emBlankCCF, emEdInit, emEdFull, emInflFull, emNcidFull

    If elComputed Then
        ' ---- EL block ----
        WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "ELECTIVE INPATIENT (EL) ADMISSIONS", _
            elEnc, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, elGreen, elPink, elLtGreen, elOrange, elDraft, _
            elTeams, elBlankCCF, elEdInit, elEdFull, elInflFull, elNcidFull

        ' ---- Combined block ----
        Dim combTeams As Object
        Set combTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        InitTeamCounts combTeams
        Dim tk As Variant
        For Each tk In emTeams.Keys
            combTeams(CStr(tk)) = emTeams(CStr(tk)) + elTeams(CStr(tk))
        Next tk

        WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "COMBINED (EM + EL)", _
            emEnc + elEnc, missedEM + missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
            emGreen + elGreen, emPink + elPink, emLtGreen + elLtGreen, emOrange + elOrange, emDraft + elDraft, _
            combTeams, emBlankCCF + elBlankCCF, _
            emEdInit + elEdInit, emEdFull + elEdFull, _
            emInflFull + elInflFull, emNcidFull + elNcidFull
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "ELECTIVE INPATIENT (EL) / COMBINED -- NOT COMPUTED"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        r = r + 1
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "The Config sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list (column D) is empty, " & _
            "so EL (Elective Inpatient / NCID AO) statistics were skipped this run. Paste the real " & _
            "Point of Care ward text values into that list and re-run to get EL and Combined figures."
        r = r + 1
        If elSkippedCount > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = elSkippedCount & " Elective Inpatient encounter(s) in File A were " & _
                "found but not processed because of this."
            r = r + 1
        End If
        r = r + 1
    End If

    ' ---- FOOTNOTES ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FOOTNOTES"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted-only encounters excluded from denominator: " & voidedTotal
    r = r + 1

    If otherEncCount > 0 Or missedOther > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Encounters with unrecognised Admission Type (not EM or EL): " & _
            otherEncCount & " from File A, " & missedOther & " from File B"
        r = r + 1
    End If

    If elPocExcluded > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Elective Inpatient encounters excluded from EL (Point of Care not in " & _
            "the configured NCID list), set aside and reported separately: " & elPocExcluded
        r = r + 1
    End If

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC source: " & missedFCSourceLabel
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Inflight duplicate exception applied (ED/EDFC candidate present, winner " & _
        "priority <= 2): " & inflightExceptionApplied & " encounter(s); blocked by the priority " & _
        "guard and fell back to the plain lowest-priority rule: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " encounter(s)"
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Unrecognised FC Status warning block (Decision 2) ----
    If Not unrecognisedStatuses Is Nothing Then
        If unrecognisedStatuses.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "UNRECOGNISED FC STATUS VALUES (counted as 'Draft only -- no FC " & _
                "outcome', priority 98 -- still IN the denominator, but check for typos or new eFC statuses)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim uk As Variant
            For Each uk In unrecognisedStatuses.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(uk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unrecognisedStatuses(uk)
                r = r + 1
            Next uk
            r = r + 1
        End If
    End If

    ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 60
    ws.Columns("B:B").ColumnWidth = 10
    ws.Columns("C:C").ColumnWidth = 10
    ws.Columns("D:D").ColumnWidth = 50
End Sub

' ---- Methodology sheet ---------------------------------------------------

Private Sub WriteMethodologySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, _
        voidedTotal As Long, elComputed As Boolean, missedFCSourceLabel As String, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        unrecognisedStatusCount As Long)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Methodology -- FC Completion Report " & reportLabel
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "1. INPUTS"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "File A: FC Summary Report (eFC export, full month, Emergency + Elective Inpatient)."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "File B: Inflight Missed FC Report (eFC export, Missed FC indicator ticked) -- OPTIONAL."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "This month's Missed FC source: " & missedFCSourceLabel & "."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "If File B is not provided, the Missed FC count is entered manually (dashboard " & _
        "workaround) and is attributed entirely to Emergency (EM) -- the dashboard workaround does not " & _
        "distinguish Elective/NCID AO missed cases, so EL's own Missed FC count is 0 for that month."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "2. FILE A CLEANING"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "a) Keep only FC Mode = 'Financial Counselling - AH' or 'Financial Counselling - Downtime'" & _
        " (en dash / em dash variants in the export are normalised to a hyphen before comparing)."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "b) Remove Admission Status = 'Cancelled'."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "c) Rank each FC ID by status priority: 1 = Completed, 2 = Acknowledgement by other means," & _
        " 3 = Virtual FC pending signature, 4-5 = Attempted/declined, 6 = Attempted, unable to complete,"
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "   98 = anything else not explicitly listed (Draft variants, blanks, typos, new eFC" & _
        " statuses -- still counted in the denominator as not completed), 99 = Voided/Deleted (matched by" & _
        " substring, e.g. 'Voided', 'Deleted by Admin' -- excluded from the denominator entirely)."
    r = r + 1
    If unrecognisedStatusCount > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "   This month: " & unrecognisedStatusCount & " distinct unrecognised (priority 98)" & _
            " status value(s) were seen -- see the warning block on the Summary sheet for the list and counts."
        r = r + 1
    End If
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "d) For encounters with multiple FC IDs: the plain rule is 'lowest priority wins, tie-" & _
        "break by larger (newer) FC ID'. The narrow Inflight exception only overrides this when (a) a non-" & _
        "Inflight candidate in the group was created by ED/EDFC staff, AND (b) the resulting winner (picked" & _
        " from the non-Inflight candidates) has priority <= 2 -- otherwise the plain rule stands."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "   This month: Inflight exception applied to " & inflightExceptionApplied & _
        " encounter(s); blocked by the priority<=2 guard (fell back to the plain rule) for " & _
        inflightExceptionBlocked & " encounter(s)."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "e) Encounters where the only FC ID was Voided/Deleted (priority 99) are excluded" & _
        " from the denominator entirely. This month: " & voidedTotal & " encounter(s) excluded."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "3. FILE B CLEANING (skipped entirely when File B is not provided)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "a) Keep only Missed FC = 'Yes'."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "b) Remove Admission Status = 'Cancelled' or 'Planned'."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "c) EDVW discharges (Point Of Care = 'TTSH Virtual Ward', Accommodation Code = 'EDVW')" & _
        " are flagged but still counted."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "4. EM/EL SPLIT"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Emergency (EM) rows are all File A rows with Admission Type = Emergency."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Elective Inpatient (EL) rows require BOTH Admission Type = Elective Inpatient AND" & _
        " Point of Care in the Config sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list -- an Elective Inpatient row whose" & _
        " Point of Care is NOT in that list is set aside and reported separately, not silently dropped."
    r = r + 1
    If elComputed Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "EL was computed this run (the NCID Point of Care list is configured)."
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "EL was NOT computed this run -- the NCID Point of Care list (Config, column D)" & _
            " is empty. See the Summary sheet for details and how many rows this affected."
    End If
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "A 'Looks Wrong' flag marks EM rows closed by NCID AO or EL rows closed by ED/EDFC or Inflight."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "5. DENOMINATOR"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Denominator = (unique encounters from File A, excluding Voided/Deleted-only) + (Missed" & _
        " FC count, from File B or manual entry -- see Section 1)."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "6. COMPLETION STATUS BANDS"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Green (priority 1-2): FC Completed with written acknowledgement."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Pink (priority 3): CCF explained but not signed."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Light Green (priority 4-5): Attempted, no further follow-up."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Orange (priority 6): FC not completed."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "White/none (priority 98): Draft only -- no FC outcome (see Section 2c)."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Grey (Missed FC): no FC ID was ever created."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "'Not completed (total)' = Orange + White/none + Grey -- the single headline 'not" & _
        " completed' figure. Splitting Drafts into their own band does not change this total or the overall" & _
        " completion percentage, only the presentation."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "7. WHO CLOSED THE CCF"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Team is determined by 'Latest CCF Creation User' via the Config roster."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "If 'Latest CCF Creation User' is blank (pure Draft, no CCF generated), falls back to 'FC Created By'."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "These fallback rows are highlighted yellow on the EM/EL data sheets."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "File B (or manual entry) missed FC rows are counted under 'CCF not generated'."
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "8. CONSERVATIVE PRINCIPLE"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "When a case is ambiguous or borderline, it is counted as NOT completed / missed."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Unrecognised FC Status values are priority 98 (not completed, but still in the" & _
        " denominator) -- only Voided/Deleted is excluded from the denominator entirely (priority 99)."

    ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 100
End Sub

' ---- Staff Roster Check sheet --------------------------------------------

Private Sub BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet(ws As Worksheet, fileAws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object)

    If roster.Count = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "Config roster is empty -- run CreateConfigSheet " & _
            "(Alt+F8) and add staff names/teams before this check is meaningful."
        ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 80
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "Cannot build roster check: Encounter column not found."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row

    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")

    Dim nameSet As Object
    Set nameSet = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    nameSet.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    If lastRow >= 2 Then
        Dim i As Long, nm As String
        If createdByCol > 0 Then
            Dim cbData As Variant
            cbData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, createdByCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
            For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
                If lastRow = 2 Then nm = CellStr(cbData) Else nm = CellStr(cbData(i, 1))
                If nm <> "" Then nameSet(nm) = True
            Next i
        End If
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
            Dim lcData As Variant
            lcData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value
            For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
                If lastRow = 2 Then nm = CellStr(lcData) Else nm = CellStr(lcData(i, 1))
                If nm <> "" Then nameSet(nm) = True
            Next i
        End If
    End If

    Dim teamOrder As Variant
    teamOrder = Array(TEAM_ED_EDFC, TEAM_INFLIGHT, TEAM_NCID_AO, TEAM_ICH_PSO, TEAM_ADMIN)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1
    Dim t As Long
    For t = LBound(teamOrder) To UBound(teamOrder)
        Dim teamName As String
        teamName = CStr(teamOrder(t))

        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = teamName
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 11
        r = r + 1

        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Staff Name"
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Matched"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
        r = r + 1

        Dim k As Variant
        For Each k In roster.Keys
            If CStr(roster(k)) = teamName Then
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = CStr(k)
                If nameSet.Exists(CStr(k)) Then
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Matched"
                Else
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Not Matched"
                    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
                    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
                End If
                r = r + 1
            End If
        Next k

        r = r + 1
    Next t

    ws.Columns("A:B").AutoFit
End Sub

' ---- Main orchestrator ---------------------------------------------------

' fileBws may be Nothing (File B is optional -- Decision 5). When Nothing,
' missedFCManualCount (from FilePickerForm's dashboard-workaround input) is
' used instead, attributed entirely to EM (see WriteMethodologySheet Section 1).
'
' ncidPocList: Dictionary from Helpers.LoadNCIDPointOfCareList. An empty
' Dictionary means the EL sheet/statistics are skipped entirely this run
' (Decision 1) -- EM is still produced normally.
Public Function BuildOutputWorkbook(fileAws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object, ncidPocList As Object, voidedOnlyCount As Long, _
        missedFCManualCount As Long, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    BuildOutputWorkbook = True

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (fileBws Is Nothing)

    Dim elComputed As Boolean
    elComputed = (ncidPocList.Count > 0)

    If Not elComputed Then
        MsgBox "The Config sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list (column D) is empty." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
               "EL (Elective Inpatient / NCID AO) statistics will be SKIPPED for this report -- only EM " & _
               "will be produced. Paste the real Point of Care ward text values into that list and re-run " & _
               "to get EL and Combined figures.", vbExclamation, "NCID Point of Care Not Configured"
    End If

    ' ---- Validate required File A columns ----
    Dim encCol As Long, admTypeCol As Long, fcStatusCol As Long
    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long, priCol As Long, pocCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    admTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Type")
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Status")
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    priCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "PRIORITISE")
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Point of Care")

    If encCol = 0 Or admTypeCol = 0 Or fcStatusCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing a required column (Encounter Number, " & _
               "Admission Type, or FC Status).", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        BuildOutputWorkbook = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' ---- Read File A data ----
    Dim aLastRow As Long, aLastCol As Long
    aLastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    aLastCol = fileAws.Cells(1, fileAws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim aData As Variant
    aData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(1, 1), fileAws.Cells(aLastRow, aLastCol)).Value

    ' ---- Build expanded array with extra columns ----
    Dim outCols As Long
    outCols = aLastCol + 3
    Dim ccfCloserCol As Long, ccfTeamCol As Long, looksWrongCol As Long
    ccfCloserCol = aLastCol + 1
    ccfTeamCol = aLastCol + 2
    looksWrongCol = aLastCol + 3

    Dim fullData() As Variant
    ReDim fullData(1 To aLastRow, 1 To outCols)

    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 1 To aLastRow
        For j = 1 To aLastCol
            fullData(i, j) = aData(i, j)
        Next j
    Next i

    fullData(1, ccfCloserCol) = "CCF Closed By"
    fullData(1, ccfTeamCol) = "CCF Closer Team"
    fullData(1, looksWrongCol) = "Looks Wrong"

    ' secArr(i) = section for fullData row i: SEC_EM, SEC_EL, or 0 (neither --
    ' excluded from both sheets). Computed once here, consumed by
    ' WriteFilteredFileASheet so the EL sheet honours the Point of Care gate.
    Dim secArr() As Long
    ReDim secArr(1 To aLastRow)

    ' ---- Compute extra columns + stats in one pass ----
    Dim greenCt(1 To 2) As Long, pinkCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim ltGreenCt(1 To 2) As Long, orangeCt(1 To 2) As Long, draftCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim encCt(1 To 2) As Long, voidCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim blankCCF(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim edInit(1 To 2) As Long, edFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim inflFull(1 To 2) As Long, ncidFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim otherEncCount As Long, elPocExcluded As Long, elSkippedCount As Long

    Dim emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object
    Set emTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set elTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts emTeams
    InitTeamCounts elTeams

    Dim unrecognisedStatuses As Object
    Set unrecognisedStatuses = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unrecognisedStatuses.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        ' Resolve CCF closer
        Dim latestCCF As String
        latestCCF = ""
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then latestCCF = CellStr(fullData(i, latestCCFCol))

        Dim createdBy As String
        createdBy = ""
        If createdByCol > 0 Then createdBy = CellStr(fullData(i, createdByCol))

        Dim ccfCloser As String
        Dim usedFallback As Boolean
        usedFallback = False
        If latestCCF <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = latestCCF
        ElseIf createdBy <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = createdBy
            usedFallback = True
        Else
            ccfCloser = ""
            usedFallback = True
        End If

        Dim team As String
        team = GetStaffTeam(roster, ccfCloser)

        fullData(i, ccfCloserCol) = ccfCloser
        fullData(i, ccfTeamCol) = team

        ' Determine section: SEC_EM, SEC_EL (gated on NCID Point of Care), or
        ' 0 = neither / excluded (Decision 1).
        Dim admType As String
        admType = UCase(CellStr(fullData(i, admTypeCol)))

        Dim sec As Long
        If admType = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
            sec = SEC_EM
        ElseIf admType = UCase(ADM_ELECTIVE) Then
            If elComputed Then
                Dim pocVal As String
                pocVal = ""
                If pocCol > 0 Then pocVal = CellStr(fullData(i, pocCol))
                If ncidPocList.Exists(pocVal) Then
                    sec = SEC_EL
                Else
                    sec = 0
                    elPocExcluded = elPocExcluded + 1
                End If
            Else
                sec = 0
                elSkippedCount = elSkippedCount + 1
            End If
        Else
            sec = 0
            otherEncCount = otherEncCount + 1
        End If
        secArr(i) = sec

        ' Looks Wrong flag
        If sec = SEC_EM And team = TEAM_NCID_AO Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        ElseIf sec = SEC_EL And (team = TEAM_ED_EDFC Or team = TEAM_INFLIGHT) Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        End If

        ' Stats (EM and EL only)
        If sec > 0 Then
            Dim pri As Long
            If priCol > 0 Then
                If IsNumeric(fullData(i, priCol)) Then
                    pri = CLng(fullData(i, priCol))
                Else
                    pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
                End If
            Else
                pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
            End If

            If pri = 99 Then
                voidCt(sec) = voidCt(sec) + 1
            Else
                encCt(sec) = encCt(sec) + 1

                If pri <= 2 Then
                    greenCt(sec) = greenCt(sec) + 1
                ElseIf pri = 3 Then
                    pinkCt(sec) = pinkCt(sec) + 1
                ElseIf pri <= 5 Then
                    ltGreenCt(sec) = ltGreenCt(sec) + 1
                ElseIf pri = 6 Then
                    orangeCt(sec) = orangeCt(sec) + 1
                Else   ' pri = 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, typos, new statuses
                    draftCt(sec) = draftCt(sec) + 1
                    Dim statusText As String
                    statusText = CellStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol))
                    If statusText = "" Then statusText = "(blank)"
                    If unrecognisedStatuses.Exists(statusText) Then
                        unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) = unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) + 1
                    Else
                        unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) = 1
                    End If
                End If

                Dim teamDict As Object
                If sec = SEC_EM Then Set teamDict = emTeams Else Set teamDict = elTeams
                teamDict(team) = teamDict(team) + 1

                If usedFallback Then blankCCF(sec) = blankCCF(sec) + 1

                ' Numerator detail
                Dim cbTeam As String, lcTeam As String
                cbTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, createdBy)
                lcTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, latestCCF)
                If cbTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then edInit(sec) = edInit(sec) + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then edFull(sec) = edFull(sec) + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then inflFull(sec) = inflFull(sec) + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_NCID_AO Then ncidFull(sec) = ncidFull(sec) + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ' ---- Missed FC count: File B (split by Admission Type) or manual entry ----
    Dim missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedOther As Long
    Dim missedFCSourceLabel As String

    If hasFileB Then
        missedFCSourceLabel = "Inflight Missed FC Report"

        Dim bEncCol As Long
        bEncCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
        If bEncCol > 0 Then
            Dim bLastRow As Long
            bLastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, bEncCol).End(xlUp).Row

            If bLastRow >= 2 Then
                Dim bAdmTypeCol As Long
                bAdmTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileBws, "Admission Type")

                If bAdmTypeCol > 0 Then
                    Dim bAdmData As Variant
                    bAdmData = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(2, bAdmTypeCol), _
                        fileBws.Cells(bLastRow, bAdmTypeCol)).Value

                    Dim bi As Long
                    For bi = 1 To bLastRow - 1
                        Dim bAdmVal As String
                        If bLastRow = 2 Then
                            bAdmVal = UCase(CellStr(bAdmData))
                        Else
                            bAdmVal = UCase(CellStr(bAdmData(bi, 1)))
                        End If

                        If bAdmVal = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
                            missedEM = missedEM + 1
                        ElseIf bAdmVal = UCase(ADM_ELECTIVE) Then
                            missedEL = missedEL + 1
                        Else
                            missedOther = missedOther + 1
                        End If
                    Next bi
                Else
                    missedEM = bLastRow - 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Else
        missedFCSourceLabel = "manual entry (dashboard workaround)"
        missedEM = missedFCManualCount
        missedEL = 0
        missedOther = 0
    End If

    ' ---- Get report period label ----
    Dim reportLabel As String
    reportLabel = GetReportPeriodLabel(fileAws)
    If reportLabel = "" Then reportLabel = "Unknown Period"

    Dim voidedTotal As Long
    voidedTotal = voidCt(1) + voidCt(2)

    ' ---- Create output workbook ----
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim outWb As Workbook
    Set outWb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)

    ' EM sheet -- always produced
    Dim wsEM As Worksheet
    Set wsEM = outWb.Sheets(1)
    wsEM.Name = SHEET_EM
    WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEM, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EM
    HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEM

    ' EL sheet -- only when the NCID Point of Care list is configured (Decision 1)
    If elComputed Then
        Dim wsEL As Worksheet
        Set wsEL = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_EL)
        WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEL, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EL
        HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEL
    End If

    ' Missed FC sheet -- only when File B was provided (Decision 5)
    If hasFileB Then
        Dim wsMissed As Worksheet
        Set wsMissed = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_MISSED_FC)
        WriteMissedFCSheet wsMissed, fileBws
    End If

    ' Summary sheet
    Dim wsSummary As Worksheet
    Set wsSummary = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_SUMMARY)
    WriteSummarySheet wsSummary, reportLabel, elComputed, elSkippedCount, elPocExcluded, _
        encCt(1), encCt(2), missedEM, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        greenCt(1), pinkCt(1), ltGreenCt(1), orangeCt(1), draftCt(1), _
        greenCt(2), pinkCt(2), ltGreenCt(2), orangeCt(2), draftCt(2), _
        emTeams, elTeams, blankCCF(1), blankCCF(2), _
        edInit(1), edFull(1), inflFull(1), ncidFull(1), _
        edInit(2), edFull(2), inflFull(2), ncidFull(2), _
        voidedTotal, otherEncCount, missedOther, unrecognisedStatuses, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked

    ' Methodology sheet
    Dim wsMethod As Worksheet
    Set wsMethod = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_METHODOLOGY)
    WriteMethodologySheet wsMethod, reportLabel, voidedTotal, elComputed, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, unrecognisedStatuses.Count

    ' Staff Roster Check sheet
    Dim wsRoster As Worksheet
    Set wsRoster = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK)
    BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet wsRoster, fileAws, roster

    ' Activate Summary sheet
    wsSummary.Activate

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    ' ---- Save via dialog ----
    Dim defaultName As String
    defaultName = "FCReportSummary_" & reportLabel & ".xlsx"

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)
    fd.title = "Save FC Completion Report"
    fd.InitialFileName = defaultName

    If fd.Show = -1 Then
        Dim savePath As String
        savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        outWb.SaveAs savePath, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
        Application.StatusBar = "Report saved: " & savePath
    Else
        MsgBox "Report was NOT saved. The output workbook is still open -- " & _
               "use File > Save As to save it manually.", vbExclamation, "Not Saved"
    End If

    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    MsgBox "Unexpected error building output workbook:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    BuildOutputWorkbook = False
End Function
