    ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value = data
    FormatHeaderRow ws, lastCol
    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
End Sub

' ---- Reconciliation waterfall (PART 3.3, 2026-07-30) ----------------------

' waterfall: Dictionary from MainMacro with keys "RowsLoaded",
' "RowsAfterModeFilter", "RowsAfterCancelledFilter", "UniqueEncounters",
' "DuplicateGroupsResolved", "DuplicateRowsRemoved",
' "EncountersLostToModeFilter" -- snapshots taken between File A cleaning
' steps. "Unique encounter numbers" and "Encounters carried forward" are the
' same figure (dedup leaves exactly one row per encounter) -- the "of which"
' lines below it are informational subsets already included in that count,
' not further subtractions. The balance-check row verifies EM + EL + neither
' reproduces that same figure.
Private Sub WriteReconciliationWaterfall(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, waterfall As Object, _
        missedTotal As Long, voidedTotal As Long, unrecognisedTotal As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, otherEncCount As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "RECONCILIATION WATERFALL"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    Dim rowsLoaded As Long, rowsAfterMode As Long, rowsAfterCancelled As Long
    Dim uniqueEnc As Long, dupGroups As Long, dupRowsRemoved As Long, lostToMode As Long
    rowsLoaded = CLng(waterfall("RowsLoaded"))
    rowsAfterMode = CLng(waterfall("RowsAfterModeFilter"))
    rowsAfterCancelled = CLng(waterfall("RowsAfterCancelledFilter"))
    uniqueEnc = CLng(waterfall("UniqueEncounters"))
    dupGroups = CLng(waterfall("DuplicateGroupsResolved"))
    dupRowsRemoved = CLng(waterfall("DuplicateRowsRemoved"))
    lostToMode = CLng(waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter"))

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Rows in File A as loaded"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = rowsLoaded
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  less rows dropped by FC Mode filter"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = -(rowsLoaded - rowsAfterMode)
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  less rows dropped by Cancelled filter"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = -(rowsAfterMode - rowsAfterCancelled)
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Unique encounter numbers"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = uniqueEnc
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  less duplicate rows removed by dedup (" & dupGroups & " encounter(s) had duplicates)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = -dupRowsRemoved
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Encounters carried forward"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = uniqueEnc
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  of which Voided/Deleted only (informational, still counted)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = voidedTotal
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  of which unrecognised status (informational, still counted)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unrecognisedTotal
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter (informational -- e.g. Shopper-only)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = lostToMode
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "plus missed FC (File B or manual entry)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedTotal
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "= DENOMINATOR"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = uniqueEnc + missedTotal
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim splitSum As Long
    splitSum = emEnc + elEnc + otherEncCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Check: EM (" & emEnc & ") + EL (" & elEnc & ") + neither (" & _
        otherEncCount & ") = " & splitSum & " vs. encounters carried forward (" & uniqueEnc & ")"
    If splitSum <> uniqueEnc Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "MISMATCH -- there is a bug in the counting logic, report this."
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(0, 128, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "OK -- balances."
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Color = RGB(0, 128, 0)
    End If
    r = r + 2
End Sub

' ---- Summary sheet -------------------------------------------------------

' Six colour bands: Green / Pink / Light Green / Orange / White-none (Draft,
' priority 98) / Voided-Deleted (priority 99, REVERT B -- back IN the
' denominator and "not completed", 2026-07-30) / Grey (Missed FC). A "Not
' completed (total)" subtotal (Orange + Draft + Voided + Missed) keeps the
' single headline figure available.
Private Sub WriteSummaryBlock(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, _
        title As String, encCount As Long, missedCount As Long, missedSourceLabel As String, _
        greenCt As Long, pinkCt As Long, ltGreenCt As Long, orangeCt As Long, draftCt As Long, voidedCt As Long, _
        teamD As Object, blankCCFCt As Long, _
        edInit As Long, edFull As Long, inflFull As Long, ncidFull As Long, _
        suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean)

    Dim denom As Long
    denom = encCount + missedCount
    Dim smallDenom As Boolean
    smallDenom = (denom < 30)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = title
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Denominator: " & denom & " encounters"
    If missedCount > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = ws.Cells(r, 1).Value & _
            " (" & encCount & " from FC Summary + " & missedCount & " missed FC, source: " & _
            missedSourceLabel & ")"
    End If
    r = r + 1
    If smallDenom Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "n too small for percentages (n < 30) -- counts only below."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 1
    End If
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- Completion status table (six colour bands) ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Completion Status"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ' Green (priority 1-2)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completed with written acknowledgement"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = greenCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, greenCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(146, 208, 80)
    r = r + 1

    ' Pink (priority 3)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF explained but not signed"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = pinkCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, pinkCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 203)
    r = r + 1

    ' Light Green (priority 4-5)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Attempted, no further follow-up"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = ltGreenCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, ltGreenCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(198, 239, 206)
    r = r + 1

    ' Orange (priority 6)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC not completed"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = orangeCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, orangeCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 0)
    r = r + 1

    ' White/none (priority 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, unrecognised statuses)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Draft only -- no FC outcome"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = draftCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, draftCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
    r = r + 1

    ' Voided/Deleted only (priority 99) -- REVERT B, 2026-07-30: counted IN
    ' the denominator and IN "not completed" now, not excluded. Uncoloured.
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted only"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = voidedCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, voidedCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
    r = r + 1

    ' Grey (File B / manual entry -- missed FC, no FC ID ever created)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC -- no FC ID created"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, missedCount, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(217, 217, 217)
    r = r + 1

    ' Not completed (total) -- Orange + Draft + Voided + Missed.
    Dim notCompletedTotal As Long
    notCompletedTotal = orangeCt + draftCt + voidedCt + missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Not completed (total)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = notCompletedTotal
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Italic = True
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, notCompletedTotal, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Font.Italic = True
    r = r + 1

    ' Total row -- visible sanity check that the bands sum to the denominator.
    Dim bandSum As Long
    bandSum = greenCt + pinkCt + ltGreenCt + orangeCt + draftCt + voidedCt + missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bandSum
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, bandSum, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    If bandSum <> denom Then
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "MISMATCH: bands sum to " & bandSum & " but denominator is " & _
            denom & " -- report this, there is a bug in the counting logic."
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
    End If
    r = r + 2

    If suppressTeamBlocks Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Who Closed the CCF / FC Activity Detail -- NOT AVAILABLE"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        r = r + 1
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "The Config staff roster is empty or matched no names in this export -- " & _
            "team attribution is unavailable this run. See the Methodology sheet for details."
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' ---- Who closed the CCF ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Who Closed the CCF"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim teams As Variant
    teams = Array(TEAM_ED_EDFC, TEAM_INFLIGHT, TEAM_NCID_AO, _
                  TEAM_ICH_PSO, TEAM_ADMIN, TEAM_OTHERS)
    Dim t As Long
    For t = LBound(teams) To UBound(teams)
        Dim tName As String
        tName = CStr(teams(t))
        Dim tCount As Long
        tCount = 0
        If teamD.Exists(tName) Then tCount = teamD(tName)
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = tName
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = tCount
        WritePctCell ws, r, 3, tCount, denom, smallDenom
        r = r + 1
    Next t

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF not generated (Missed FC)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, missedCount, denom, smallDenom
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = denom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = 1
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True

    If blankCCFCt > 0 Then
        r = r + 1
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  (" & blankCCFCt & _
            " encounter(s) had blank 'Latest CCF Creation User' -- fell back to 'FC Created By')"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- FC Activity Detail ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Activity Detail"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC created by EDFC (initial -- FC Created By)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = edInit
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by EDFC (Latest CCF Creation User)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = edFull
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by Inflight"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = inflFull
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by NCID AO"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = ncidFull
    r = r + 3
End Sub

Private Sub WriteSummarySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, waterfall As Object, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedFCSourceLabel As String, _
        emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, emOrange As Long, emDraft As Long, emVoided As Long, _
        elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long, elOrange As Long, elDraft As Long, elVoided As Long, _
        emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object, _
        emBlankCCF As Long, elBlankCCF As Long, _
        emEdInit As Long, emEdFull As Long, emInflFull As Long, emNcidFull As Long, _
        elEdInit As Long, elEdFull As Long, elInflFull As Long, elNcidFull As Long, _
        ncidEnc As Long, ncidGreen As Long, ncidPink As Long, ncidLtGreen As Long, ncidOrange As Long, _
        ncidDraft As Long, ncidVoided As Long, ncidTeams As Object, ncidBlankCCF As Long, _
        ncidEdInit As Long, ncidEdFull As Long, ncidInflFull As Long, ncidNcidFull As Long, _
        voidedTotal As Long, otherEncCount As Long, missedOther As Long, _
        unrecognisedStatuses As Object, unmatchedNCIDWards As Object, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        modeFilterExcludedEncounters As Long, _
        suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean, rosterCoverage As Double, unmatchedNames As Object)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completion Report -- " & reportLabel
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Reconciliation waterfall (PART 3.3) ----
    WriteReconciliationWaterfall ws, r, waterfall, missedEM + missedEL + missedOther, _
        voidedTotal, unrecognisedStatuses.Count, emEnc, elEnc, otherEncCount

    If suppressTeamBlocks Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "STAFF ROSTER NOT MATCHED -- team attribution and all four " & _
            "numerator indicators are unavailable this run (the Config roster is empty or matched " & _
            "no names in this export). Completion statistics below are still valid."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        r = r + 2
    End If

    ' ---- EM block (always computed) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "EMERGENCY (EM) ADMISSIONS", _
        emEnc, missedEM, missedFCSourceLabel, emGreen, emPink, emLtGreen, emOrange, emDraft, emVoided, _
        emTeams, emBlankCCF, emEdInit, emEdFull, emInflFull, emNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- EL block (Revert A, 2026-07-30: always computed -- Admission Type alone) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "ELECTIVE INPATIENT (EL) ADMISSIONS", _
        elEnc, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, elGreen, elPink, elLtGreen, elOrange, elDraft, elVoided, _
        elTeams, elBlankCCF, elEdInit, elEdFull, elInflFull, elNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- of which NCID wards (PART 3.1 sub-block under EL) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "  of which NCID wards (subset of EL)", _
        ncidEnc, 0, missedFCSourceLabel, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoided, _
        ncidTeams, ncidBlankCCF, ncidEdInit, ncidEdFull, ncidInflFull, ncidNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- Combined block ----
    Dim combTeams As Object
    Set combTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts combTeams
    Dim tk As Variant
    For Each tk In emTeams.Keys
        combTeams(CStr(tk)) = emTeams(CStr(tk)) + elTeams(CStr(tk))
    Next tk

    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "COMBINED (EM + EL)", _
        emEnc + elEnc, missedEM + missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        emGreen + elGreen, emPink + elPink, emLtGreen + elLtGreen, emOrange + elOrange, _
        emDraft + elDraft, emVoided + elVoided, _
        combTeams, emBlankCCF + elBlankCCF, _
        emEdInit + elEdInit, emEdFull + elEdFull, _
        emInflFull + elInflFull, emNcidFull + elNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- FOOTNOTES ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FOOTNOTES"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted-only encounters (counted IN the denominator and IN " & _
        "'not completed', REVERT B 2026-07-30): " & voidedTotal
    r = r + 1

    If otherEncCount > 0 Or missedOther > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Encounters with unrecognised Admission Type (not EM or EL): " & _
            otherEncCount & " from File A, " & missedOther & " from File B"
        r = r + 1
    End If

    If modeFilterExcludedEncounters > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = modeFilterExcludedEncounters & " encounter(s) excluded -- only form " & _
            "was a Shopper enquiry or other non-FC mode."
        r = r + 1
    End If

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC source: " & missedFCSourceLabel
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Inflight duplicate exception applied (ED/EDFC candidate present, winner " & _
        "priority <= 2): " & inflightExceptionApplied & " encounter(s); blocked by the priority " & _
        "guard and fell back to the plain lowest-priority rule: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " encounter(s)"
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Unrecognised FC Status warning block ----
    If Not unrecognisedStatuses Is Nothing Then
        If unrecognisedStatuses.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "UNRECOGNISED FC STATUS VALUES (counted as 'Draft only -- no FC " & _
                "outcome', priority 98 -- still IN the denominator, but check for typos or new eFC statuses)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim uk As Variant
            For Each uk In unrecognisedStatuses.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(uk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unrecognisedStatuses(uk)
                r = r + 1
            Next uk
            r = r + 1
        End If
    End If

    ' ---- Unmatched "NCID" Point of Care values warning (PART 3.1) ----
    If Not unmatchedNCIDWards Is Nothing Then
        If unmatchedNCIDWards.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "POINT OF CARE VALUES CONTAINING 'NCID' NOT IN THE CONFIGURED LIST " & _
                "(still counted normally -- check whether a new NCID ward needs adding to the Config " & _
                "sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim nk As Variant
            For Each nk In unmatchedNCIDWards.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(nk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unmatchedNCIDWards(nk)
                r = r + 1
            Next nk
            r = r + 1
        End If
    End If

    ' ---- Low roster coverage: unmatched staff names (PART 4.1) ----
    If Not suppressTeamBlocks And rosterCoverage < 0.7 And rosterCoverage > 0 Then
        If Not unmatchedNames Is Nothing Then
            If unmatchedNames.Count > 0 Then
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "LOW ROSTER COVERAGE (" & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%") & _
                    ") -- UNMATCHED STAFF NAMES (add these to the Config roster for the biggest gain)"
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
                r = r + 1

                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Staff Name (as it appears in this export)"
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Encounter Count"
                ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
                r = r + 1

                Dim sortedNames As Variant
                sortedNames = SortDictKeysDescending(unmatchedNames)
                Dim si As Long
                For si = LBound(sortedNames) To UBound(sortedNames)
                    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(sortedNames(si))
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unmatchedNames(CStr(sortedNames(si)))
                    r = r + 1
                Next si
                r = r + 1
            End If
        End If
    End If

    ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 70
    ws.Columns("B:B").ColumnWidth = 12
    ws.Columns("C:C").ColumnWidth = 10
    ws.Columns("D:D").ColumnWidth = 50
End Sub

' ---- Methodology sheet ---------------------------------------------------

Private Sub WriteMethodologySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, _

    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "a) Keep only FC Mode = 'Financial Counselling - AH' or 'Financial Counselling - Downtime'" & _

    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "c) Rank each FC ID by status priority: 1 = Completed, 2 = Acknowledgement by other means," & _

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "   98 = anything else not explicitly listed (Draft variants, blanks, typos, new eFC" & _

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "d) For encounters with multiple FC IDs: the plain rule is 'lowest priority wins, tie-" & _

        "Deleted (priority 99) are counted IN the denominator and IN 'not completed' -- they get their own" & _
        " 'Voided/Deleted only' Summary row. This matches actual practice (the manual report includes them);" & _
        " an earlier version of this macro excluded them, which disagreed with practice. This month: " & _

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "3. FILE B CLEANING (skipped entirely when File B is not provided)"

    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "White/none (priority 98): Draft only -- no FC outcome (see Section 2c)."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted only (priority 99): counted IN the denominator and 'not completed'" & _

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Grey (Missed FC): no FC ID was ever created."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "'Not completed (total)' = Orange + White/none + Voided/Deleted + Grey -- the single" & _
        " headline 'not completed' figure."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Blocks with a denominator under 30 (e.g. the NCID ward sub-block) show counts only --" & _
        " percentages are suppressed as misleading at that sample size."

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "7. WHO CLOSED THE CCF"

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Team is determined by 'Latest CCF Creation User' via the Config roster."
    r = r + 1

    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "These fallback rows are highlighted yellow on the EM/EL data sheets."
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "File B (or manual entry) missed FC rows are counted under 'CCF not generated'."
    r = r + 1
    If suppressTeamBlocks Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "THIS MONTH: the Config staff roster is empty or matched no names in this" & _
            " export (0% coverage) -- 'Who Closed the CCF' and 'FC Activity Detail' are UNAVAILABLE. Run" & _

    r = r + 1

        " denominator); Voided/Deleted is priority 99 (also not completed, also in the denominator, REVERT B)."

End Sub

' ---- Staff Roster Check sheet --------------------------------------------

' unmatchedNames: Dictionary from Helpers.ComputeRosterCoverage (resolved CCF
' closer name -> encounter count) for names that did NOT map to a named
' team. Listed here regardless of coverage tier (PART 4.1, third bullet).
Private Sub BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet(ws As Worksheet, fileAws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object, unmatchedNames As Object)

    If roster.Count = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "Config roster is empty -- run CreateConfigSheet " & _
            "(Alt+F8) and add staff names/teams before this check is meaningful. " & _
            "SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare (Alt+F8) can bootstrap a starting roster from an export."
        ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 80
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "Cannot build roster check: Encounter column not found."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row

    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")

    Dim nameSet As Object
    Set nameSet = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    nameSet.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    If lastRow >= 2 Then
        Dim i As Long, nm As String
        If createdByCol > 0 Then
            Dim cbData As Variant
            cbData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, createdByCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
            For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
                If lastRow = 2 Then nm = CellStr(cbData) Else nm = CellStr(cbData(i, 1))
                If nm <> "" Then nameSet(nm) = True
            Next i
        End If
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
            Dim lcData As Variant
            lcData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value
            For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
                If lastRow = 2 Then nm = CellStr(lcData) Else nm = CellStr(lcData(i, 1))
                If nm <> "" Then nameSet(nm) = True
            Next i
        End If
    End If

    Dim teamOrder As Variant
    teamOrder = Array(TEAM_ED_EDFC, TEAM_INFLIGHT, TEAM_NCID_AO, TEAM_ICH_PSO, TEAM_ADMIN)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1
    Dim t As Long
    For t = LBound(teamOrder) To UBound(teamOrder)
        Dim teamName As String
        teamName = CStr(teamOrder(t))

        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = teamName
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 11
        r = r + 1

        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Staff Name"
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Matched"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
        r = r + 1

        Dim k As Variant
        For Each k In roster.Keys
            If CStr(roster(k)) = teamName Then
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = CStr(k)
                If nameSet.Exists(CStr(k)) Then
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Matched"
                Else
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Not Matched"
                    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
                    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
                End If
                r = r + 1
            End If
        Next k

        r = r + 1
    Next t

    ' ---- Unmatched export names (PART 4.1, always listed) ----
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Unmatched names in this export (resolved CCF closer -> mapped to 'Others')"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 11
    r = r + 1

    If unmatchedNames Is Nothing Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(roster coverage check was not run)"
        r = r + 1
    ElseIf unmatchedNames.Count = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(none -- 100% of encounters matched a named team)"
        r = r + 1
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Staff Name"
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Encounter Count"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
        r = r + 1

        Dim sortedNames As Variant
        sortedNames = SortDictKeysDescending(unmatchedNames)
        Dim si As Long
        For si = LBound(sortedNames) To UBound(sortedNames)
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = CStr(sortedNames(si))
            ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unmatchedNames(CStr(sortedNames(si)))
            r = r + 1
        Next si
    End If

    ws.Columns("A:B").AutoFit
End Sub

' ---- Main orchestrator ---------------------------------------------------

' fileBws may be Nothing (File B is optional). When Nothing, missedFCManualCount
' (from FilePickerForm's dashboard-workaround input) is used instead,
' attributed entirely to EM (see WriteMethodologySheet Section 1).
'
' ncidPocList: Dictionary from Helpers.LoadNCIDPointOfCareList -- purely
' informational (PART 3.1); does NOT gate the EL sheet (Revert A).
'
' waterfall: Dictionary from MainMacro with the row/encounter-count snapshots
' for the reconciliation waterfall (see WriteReconciliationWaterfall).
'
' rosterCoverage / unmatchedNames / suppressTeamBlocks: from Helpers.
' ComputeRosterCoverage, run in MainMacro before this function (PART 4.1).
Public Function BuildOutputWorkbook(fileAws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object, ncidPocList As Object, missedFCManualCount As Long, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        waterfall As Object, _
        rosterCoverage As Double, unmatchedNames As Object, suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    BuildOutputWorkbook = True

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (fileBws Is Nothing)

    ' ---- Validate required File A columns ----
    Dim encCol As Long, admTypeCol As Long, fcStatusCol As Long
    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long, priCol As Long, pocCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    admTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Type")
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Status")
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    priCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "PRIORITISE")
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Point of Care")

    If encCol = 0 Or admTypeCol = 0 Or fcStatusCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing a required column (Encounter Number, " & _
               "Admission Type, or FC Status).", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        BuildOutputWorkbook = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' ---- Read File A data ----
    Dim aLastRow As Long, aLastCol As Long
    aLastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    aLastCol = fileAws.Cells(1, fileAws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim aData As Variant
    aData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(1, 1), fileAws.Cells(aLastRow, aLastCol)).Value

    ' ---- Build expanded array with extra columns ----
    Dim outCols As Long
    outCols = aLastCol + 4
    Dim ccfCloserCol As Long, ccfTeamCol As Long, looksWrongCol As Long, ncidWardCol As Long
    ccfCloserCol = aLastCol + 1
    ccfTeamCol = aLastCol + 2
    looksWrongCol = aLastCol + 3
    ncidWardCol = aLastCol + 4

    Dim fullData() As Variant
    ReDim fullData(1 To aLastRow, 1 To outCols)

    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 1 To aLastRow
        For j = 1 To aLastCol
            fullData(i, j) = aData(i, j)
        Next j
    Next i

    fullData(1, ccfCloserCol) = "CCF Closed By"
    fullData(1, ccfTeamCol) = "CCF Closer Team"
    fullData(1, looksWrongCol) = "Looks Wrong"
    fullData(1, ncidWardCol) = "NCID Ward"

    ' secArr(i) = section for fullData row i: SEC_EM, SEC_EL, or 0 (neither).
    Dim secArr() As Long
    ReDim secArr(1 To aLastRow)

    ' ---- Compute extra columns + stats in one pass ----
    Dim greenCt(1 To 2) As Long, pinkCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim ltGreenCt(1 To 2) As Long, orangeCt(1 To 2) As Long, draftCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim encCt(1 To 2) As Long, voidCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim blankCCF(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim edInit(1 To 2) As Long, edFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim inflFull(1 To 2) As Long, ncidFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim otherEncCount As Long

    ' NCID ward subset (of EL) -- PART 3.1
    Dim ncidEnc As Long, ncidGreen As Long, ncidPink As Long, ncidLtGreen As Long
    Dim ncidOrange As Long, ncidDraft As Long, ncidVoid As Long, ncidBlankCCF As Long
    Dim ncidEdInit As Long, ncidEdFull As Long, ncidInflFull As Long, ncidNcidFull As Long
    Dim ncidTeams As Object
    Set ncidTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts ncidTeams

    Dim emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object
    Set emTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set elTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts emTeams
    InitTeamCounts elTeams

    Dim unrecognisedStatuses As Object
    Set unrecognisedStatuses = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unrecognisedStatuses.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim unmatchedNCIDWards As Object
    Set unmatchedNCIDWards = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unmatchedNCIDWards.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        ' Resolve CCF closer
        Dim latestCCF As String
        latestCCF = ""
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then latestCCF = CellStr(fullData(i, latestCCFCol))

        Dim createdBy As String
        createdBy = ""
        If createdByCol > 0 Then createdBy = CellStr(fullData(i, createdByCol))

        Dim ccfCloser As String
        Dim usedFallback As Boolean
        usedFallback = False
        If latestCCF <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = latestCCF
        ElseIf createdBy <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = createdBy
            usedFallback = True
        Else
            ccfCloser = ""
            usedFallback = True
        End If

        Dim team As String
        team = GetStaffTeam(roster, ccfCloser)

        fullData(i, ccfCloserCol) = ccfCloser
        fullData(i, ccfTeamCol) = team

        ' NCID Ward informational column + unmatched-"NCID"-value warning (PART 3.1)
        Dim pocValRaw As String
        pocValRaw = ""
        If pocCol > 0 Then pocValRaw = CellStr(fullData(i, pocCol))

        Dim isNCIDWard As Boolean
        isNCIDWard = (pocValRaw <> "" And ncidPocList.Exists(pocValRaw))
        If isNCIDWard Then
            fullData(i, ncidWardCol) = "Yes"
        Else
            fullData(i, ncidWardCol) = "No"
        End If

        If pocValRaw <> "" And InStr(UCase(pocValRaw), "NCID") > 0 And Not ncidPocList.Exists(pocValRaw) Then
            If unmatchedNCIDWards.Exists(pocValRaw) Then
                unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) = unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) + 1
            Else
                unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) = 1
            End If
        End If

        ' Determine section: SEC_EM, SEC_EL (Admission Type alone -- Revert A), or 0 = neither.
        Dim admType As String
        admType = UCase(CellStr(fullData(i, admTypeCol)))

        Dim sec As Long
        If admType = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
            sec = SEC_EM
        ElseIf IsElectiveAdmType(admType) Then
            sec = SEC_EL
        Else
            sec = 0
            otherEncCount = otherEncCount + 1
        End If
        secArr(i) = sec

        ' Looks Wrong flag
        If sec = SEC_EM And team = TEAM_NCID_AO Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        ElseIf sec = SEC_EL And (team = TEAM_ED_EDFC Or team = TEAM_INFLIGHT) Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        End If

        ' Stats (EM and EL only)
        If sec > 0 Then
            Dim pri As Long
            If priCol > 0 Then
                If IsNumeric(fullData(i, priCol)) Then
                    pri = CLng(fullData(i, priCol))
                Else
                    pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
                End If
            Else
                pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
            End If

            encCt(sec) = encCt(sec) + 1
            ClassifyIntoBand pri, greenCt(sec), pinkCt(sec), ltGreenCt(sec), orangeCt(sec), draftCt(sec), voidCt(sec)

            If pri = 98 Then
                Dim statusText As String
                statusText = CellStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol))
                If statusText = "" Then statusText = "(blank)"
                If unrecognisedStatuses.Exists(statusText) Then
                    unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) = unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) + 1
                Else
                    unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) = 1
                End If
            End If

            Dim teamDict As Object
            If sec = SEC_EM Then Set teamDict = emTeams Else Set teamDict = elTeams
            teamDict(team) = teamDict(team) + 1

            If usedFallback Then blankCCF(sec) = blankCCF(sec) + 1

            ' Numerator detail
            Dim cbTeam As String, lcTeam As String
            cbTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, createdBy)
            lcTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, latestCCF)
            If cbTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then edInit(sec) = edInit(sec) + 1
            If lcTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then edFull(sec) = edFull(sec) + 1
            If lcTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then inflFull(sec) = inflFull(sec) + 1
            If lcTeam = TEAM_NCID_AO Then ncidFull(sec) = ncidFull(sec) + 1

            ' NCID ward subset of EL (PART 3.1)
            If sec = SEC_EL And isNCIDWard Then
                ncidEnc = ncidEnc + 1
                ClassifyIntoBand pri, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoid
                ncidTeams(team) = ncidTeams(team) + 1
                If usedFallback Then ncidBlankCCF = ncidBlankCCF + 1
                If cbTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then ncidEdInit = ncidEdInit + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then ncidEdFull = ncidEdFull + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then ncidInflFull = ncidInflFull + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_NCID_AO Then ncidNcidFull = ncidNcidFull + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ' ---- Missed FC count: File B (split by Admission Type) or manual entry ----
    Dim missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedOther As Long
    Dim missedFCSourceLabel As String

    If hasFileB Then
        missedFCSourceLabel = "Inflight Missed FC Report"

        Dim bEncCol As Long
        bEncCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
        If bEncCol > 0 Then
            Dim bLastRow As Long
            bLastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, bEncCol).End(xlUp).Row

            If bLastRow >= 2 Then
                Dim bAdmTypeCol As Long
                bAdmTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileBws, "Admission Type")

                If bAdmTypeCol > 0 Then
                    Dim bAdmData As Variant
                    bAdmData = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(2, bAdmTypeCol), _
                        fileBws.Cells(bLastRow, bAdmTypeCol)).Value

                    Dim bi As Long
                    For bi = 1 To bLastRow - 1
                        Dim bAdmVal As String
                        If bLastRow = 2 Then
                            bAdmVal = UCase(CellStr(bAdmData))
                        Else
                            bAdmVal = UCase(CellStr(bAdmData(bi, 1)))
                        End If

                        If bAdmVal = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
                            missedEM = missedEM + 1
                        ElseIf IsElectiveAdmType(bAdmVal) Then
                            missedEL = missedEL + 1
                        Else
                            missedOther = missedOther + 1
                        End If
                    Next bi
                Else
                    missedEM = bLastRow - 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Else
        missedFCSourceLabel = "manual entry (dashboard workaround)"
        missedEM = missedFCManualCount
        missedEL = 0
        missedOther = 0
    End If

    ' ---- Get report period label ----
    Dim reportLabel As String
    reportLabel = GetReportPeriodLabel(fileAws)
    If reportLabel = "" Then reportLabel = "Unknown Period"

    Dim voidedTotal As Long
    voidedTotal = voidCt(1) + voidCt(2)

    ' ---- Create output workbook ----
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim outWb As Workbook
    Set outWb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)

    ' EM sheet -- always produced
    Dim wsEM As Worksheet
    Set wsEM = outWb.Sheets(1)
    wsEM.Name = SHEET_EM
    WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEM, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EM
    HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEM

    ' EL sheet -- always produced (Revert A, 2026-07-30: no longer gated)
    Dim wsEL As Worksheet
    Set wsEL = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_EL)
    WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEL, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EL
    HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEL

    ' Missed FC sheet -- only when File B was provided
    If hasFileB Then
        Dim wsMissed As Worksheet
        Set wsMissed = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_MISSED_FC)
        WriteMissedFCSheet wsMissed, fileBws
    End If

    ' Summary sheet
    Dim wsSummary As Worksheet
    Set wsSummary = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_SUMMARY)
    WriteSummarySheet wsSummary, reportLabel, waterfall, _
        encCt(1), encCt(2), missedEM, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        greenCt(1), pinkCt(1), ltGreenCt(1), orangeCt(1), draftCt(1), voidCt(1), _
        greenCt(2), pinkCt(2), ltGreenCt(2), orangeCt(2), draftCt(2), voidCt(2), _
        emTeams, elTeams, blankCCF(1), blankCCF(2), _
        edInit(1), edFull(1), inflFull(1), ncidFull(1), _
        edInit(2), edFull(2), inflFull(2), ncidFull(2), _
        ncidEnc, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoid, ncidTeams, ncidBlankCCF, _
        ncidEdInit, ncidEdFull, ncidInflFull, ncidNcidFull, _
        voidedTotal, otherEncCount, missedOther, unrecognisedStatuses, unmatchedNCIDWards, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, _
        CLng(waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter")), _
        suppressTeamBlocks, rosterCoverage, unmatchedNames

    ' Methodology sheet
    Dim wsMethod As Worksheet
    Set wsMethod = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_METHODOLOGY)
    WriteMethodologySheet wsMethod, reportLabel, voidedTotal, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, unrecognisedStatuses.Count, _
        CLng(waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter")), suppressTeamBlocks, rosterCoverage

    ' Staff Roster Check sheet
    Dim wsRoster As Worksheet
    Set wsRoster = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK)
    BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet wsRoster, fileAws, roster, unmatchedNames

    ' Activate Summary sheet
    wsSummary.Activate

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    ' ---- Save via dialog ----
    Dim defaultName As String
    defaultName = "FCReportSummary_" & reportLabel & ".xlsx"

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)
    fd.title = "Save FC Completion Report"
    fd.InitialFileName = defaultName

    If fd.Show = -1 Then
        Dim savePath As String
        savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        outWb.SaveAs savePath, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
        Application.StatusBar = "Report saved: " & savePath
    Else
        MsgBox "Report was NOT saved. The output workbook is still open -- " & _
               "use File > Save As to save it manually.", vbExclamation, "Not Saved"
    End If

    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    MsgBox "Unexpected error building output workbook:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    BuildOutputWorkbook = False
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "MainMacro"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' MainMacro.bas
'
' Entry point: GenerateFCCompletionReport (run via Alt+F8).
' Orchestrates the full pipeline:
'   1. FilePickerForm -- select File A (required) and File B (optional)
'   2. Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list from Config sheet
'   3. Clean File A (FC Mode filter, cancel filter, dedup), snapshotting row/
'      encounter counts along the way for the Summary sheet reconciliation
'      waterfall (PART 3.3, 2026-07-30)
'   4. Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) -- measures what fraction
'      of encounters map to a named team; warns or aborts before an empty/
'      unmatched roster silently reports 100% "Others"
'   5. Clean File B (FC Mode filter, Missed FC filter, cancel/planned, EDVW
'      flag) -- SKIPPED entirely if File B was not provided
'   6. Build output workbook (EM/EL split, Summary, Methodology, Roster Check)
'   7. Close input files, show success summary
'
' Step numbering is computed dynamically (stepNum/totalSteps) rather than
' hardcoded, so the progress bar adapts automatically to whether File B's
' four cleaning steps are present.
' ============================================================

Public Sub GenerateFCCompletionReport()

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    ' ---- Step 0: File picker ----
    Dim picker As FilePickerForm
    Set picker = New FilePickerForm
    If Not picker.ShowFilePicker Then Exit Sub

    Dim wbA As Workbook, wbB As Workbook
    Set wbA = picker.SelectedFileA
    Set wbB = picker.SelectedFileB

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (wbB Is Nothing)

    Dim wsA As Worksheet, wsB As Worksheet
    Set wsA = wbA.Sheets(1)
    If hasFileB Then Set wsB = wbB.Sheets(1)

    ' ---- Show progress (9 steps always + 4 more if File B is present) ----
    Dim totalSteps As Long
    totalSteps = 9
    If hasFileB Then totalSteps = totalSteps + 4
    ProgressForm.ShowProgress totalSteps

    Dim stepNum As Long
    stepNum = 0

    ' ---- Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Loading staff roster and NCID Point of Care list"
    Dim roster As Object
    Set roster = LoadStaffRoster()
    Dim ncidPocList As Object
    Set ncidPocList = LoadNCIDPointOfCareList()

    ' ---- Clean File A ----
    ' Waterfall snapshot: rows as loaded + distinct encounters before the FC
    ' Mode filter (PART 2.4 / 3.3, 2026-07-30).
    Dim rowsLoadedA As Long
    rowsLoadedA = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim encSetBeforeMode As Object
    Set encSetBeforeMode = GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- filtering FC Mode"
    If Not FilterFCMode(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    Dim rowsAfterMode As Long
    rowsAfterMode = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim encountersLostToModeFilter As Long
    encountersLostToModeFilter = CountKeysNotIn(encSetBeforeMode, GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA))

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- removing cancelled admissions"
    If Not DeleteCancelledAdmissions(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    Dim rowsAfterCancelled As Long
    rowsAfterCancelled = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup As Long
    uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup = GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA).Count

    ' ---- Deduplicate File A ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- adding priority column"
    AddPriorityColumn wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- highlighting duplicate encounters"
    MarkDuplicateEncounters wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- resolving duplicates"
    Dim voidedOnlyCount As Long
    Dim dupGroupsResolved As Long
    Dim dupRowsRemoved As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionApplied As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionBlocked As Long
    If Not ResolveDuplicateEncounters(wsA, roster, voidedOnlyCount, _
            dupGroupsResolved, dupRowsRemoved, _
            inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked) Then GoTo Cleanup

    ' ---- Waterfall dictionary (PART 3.3) -- consumed by BuildOutput.bas's
    ' WriteReconciliationWaterfall on the Summary sheet.
    Dim waterfall As Object
    Set waterfall = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    waterfall("RowsLoaded") = rowsLoadedA
    waterfall("RowsAfterModeFilter") = rowsAfterMode
    waterfall("RowsAfterCancelledFilter") = rowsAfterCancelled
    waterfall("UniqueEncounters") = uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup
    waterfall("DuplicateGroupsResolved") = dupGroupsResolved
    waterfall("DuplicateRowsRemoved") = dupRowsRemoved
    waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter") = encountersLostToModeFilter

    ' ---- Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) ----
    ' Run after File A cleaning/dedup, before BuildOutputWorkbook, so an
    ' empty/unmatched roster is caught here rather than silently producing a
    ' Summary claiming 100% of CCFs were closed by "Others".
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Checking staff roster coverage"
    Dim unmatchedNames As Object
    Dim rosterCoverage As Double
    rosterCoverage = ComputeRosterCoverage(wsA, roster, unmatchedNames)

    Dim suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean
    suppressTeamBlocks = False

    If rosterCoverage = 0 Then
        Dim resp As VbMsgBoxResult
        resp = MsgBox("The staff roster (Config sheet) is empty, or doesn't match any names in " & _
            "this export." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "'Who Closed the CCF' and all four numerator indicators (FC created by EDFC, CCF " & _
            "closed by EDFC/Inflight/NCID AO) will be UNAVAILABLE for this report." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "Continue and produce completion statistics only?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, _
            "Staff Roster Not Matched")
        If resp = vbNo Then GoTo Cleanup
        suppressTeamBlocks = True
    ElseIf rosterCoverage < 0.7 Then
        MsgBox "Staff roster coverage is low: only " & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%") & _
            " of encounters matched a named team." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "The report will still be produced, but unmatched staff names will be listed on the " & _
            "Summary sheet (largest first) so you can see which names to add to the Config roster.", _
            vbInformation, "Low Roster Coverage"
    End If

    ' ---- Clean File B (skipped entirely if not provided) ----
    If hasFileB Then
        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- filtering FC Mode"
        If Not FilterFCModeIfPresent(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- keeping Missed FC rows"
        If Not KeepOnlyMissedFC(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- removing cancelled/planned"
        If Not DeleteCancelledOrPlanned(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- flagging EDVW discharges"
        FlagEDVWDischarges wsB
    End If

    ' ---- Build output ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Building output workbook"
    Dim outputOK As Boolean
    outputOK = BuildOutputWorkbook(wsA, wsB, roster, ncidPocList, _
        picker.MissedFCManualCount, inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, _
        waterfall, rosterCoverage, unmatchedNames, suppressTeamBlocks)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Done"

    ' ---- Cleanup: close input files ----
    On Error Resume Next
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    On Error GoTo 0

    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False

    If outputOK Then
        Dim msg As String
        msg = "FC Completion Report generated successfully." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
              "Duplicate encounters resolved: " & dupGroupsResolved & _
              " (" & dupRowsRemoved & " row(s) removed)" & vbNewLine & _
              "Voided/Deleted-only encounters (counted in denominator, REVERT B): " & voidedOnlyCount & vbNewLine & _
              "Encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter (e.g. Shopper-only): " & _
              encountersLostToModeFilter & vbNewLine & _
              "Inflight duplicate exception applied: " & inflightExceptionApplied & _
              " group(s); blocked by the priority<=2 guard: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " group(s)"
        If suppressTeamBlocks Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "Staff roster coverage: 0%% -- 'Who Closed the CCF' and numerator indicators were " & _
                  "suppressed this run."
            msg = Replace(msg, "0%%", "0%")
        Else
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "Staff roster coverage: " & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%")
        End If
        If Not hasFileB Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "File B was not provided -- Missed FC count used manual entry: " & _
                  picker.MissedFCManualCount
        End If
        MsgBox msg, vbInformation, "Complete"
    Else
        MsgBox "Report generation encountered an error. Check the output workbook " & _
               "(if open) for partial results.", vbExclamation, "Warning"
    End If

    Exit Sub

Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    Application.StatusBar = False
    On Error GoTo 0
    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    On Error GoTo 0
    MsgBox "Unexpected error:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
End Sub

    If hasFileB Then Set wsB = wbB.Sheets(1)

    ' ---- Show progress (9 steps always + 4 more if File B is present) ----
    Dim totalSteps As Long
    totalSteps = 9
    If hasFileB Then totalSteps = totalSteps + 4
    ProgressForm.ShowProgress totalSteps

    Dim stepNum As Long
    stepNum = 0

    ' ---- Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Loading staff roster and NCID Point of Care list"
    Dim roster As Object
    Set roster = LoadStaffRoster()
    Dim ncidPocList As Object
    Set ncidPocList = LoadNCIDPointOfCareList()

    ' ---- Clean File A ----
    ' Waterfall snapshot: rows as loaded + distinct encounters before the FC
    ' Mode filter (PART 2.4 / 3.3, 2026-07-30).
    Dim rowsLoadedA As Long
    rowsLoadedA = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim encSetBeforeMode As Object
    Set encSetBeforeMode = GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- filtering FC Mode"
    If Not FilterFCMode(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    Dim rowsAfterMode As Long
    rowsAfterMode = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim encountersLostToModeFilter As Long
    encountersLostToModeFilter = CountKeysNotIn(encSetBeforeMode, GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA))

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- removing cancelled admissions"
    If Not DeleteCancelledAdmissions(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    Dim rowsAfterCancelled As Long
    rowsAfterCancelled = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup As Long
    uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup = GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA).Count

    ' ---- Deduplicate File A ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- adding priority column"
    AddPriorityColumn wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- highlighting duplicate encounters"
    MarkDuplicateEncounters wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- resolving duplicates"
    Dim voidedOnlyCount As Long
    Dim dupGroupsResolved As Long
    Dim dupRowsRemoved As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionApplied As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionBlocked As Long
    If Not ResolveDuplicateEncounters(wsA, roster, voidedOnlyCount, _
            dupGroupsResolved, dupRowsRemoved, _
            inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked) Then GoTo Cleanup

    ' ---- Waterfall dictionary (PART 3.3) -- consumed by BuildOutput.bas's
    ' WriteReconciliationWaterfall on the Summary sheet.
    Dim waterfall As Object
    Set waterfall = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    waterfall("RowsLoaded") = rowsLoadedA
    waterfall("RowsAfterModeFilter") = rowsAfterMode
    waterfall("RowsAfterCancelledFilter") = rowsAfterCancelled
    waterfall("UniqueEncounters") = uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup
    waterfall("DuplicateGroupsResolved") = dupGroupsResolved
    waterfall("DuplicateRowsRemoved") = dupRowsRemoved
    waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter") = encountersLostToModeFilter

    ' ---- Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) ----
    ' Run after File A cleaning/dedup, before BuildOutputWorkbook, so an
    ' empty/unmatched roster is caught here rather than silently producing a
    ' Summary claiming 100% of CCFs were closed by "Others".
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Checking staff roster coverage"
    Dim unmatchedNames As Object
    Dim rosterCoverage As Double
    rosterCoverage = ComputeRosterCoverage(wsA, roster, unmatchedNames)

    Dim suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean
    suppressTeamBlocks = False

    If rosterCoverage = 0 Then
        Dim resp As VbMsgBoxResult
        resp = MsgBox("The staff roster (Config sheet) is empty, or doesn't match any names in " & _
            "this export." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "'Who Closed the CCF' and all four numerator indicators (FC created by EDFC, CCF " & _
            "closed by EDFC/Inflight/NCID AO) will be UNAVAILABLE for this report." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "Continue and produce completion statistics only?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, _
            "Staff Roster Not Matched")
        If resp = vbNo Then GoTo Cleanup
        suppressTeamBlocks = True
    ElseIf rosterCoverage < 0.7 Then
        MsgBox "Staff roster coverage is low: only " & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%") & _
            " of encounters matched a named team." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "The report will still be produced, but unmatched staff names will be listed on the " & _
            "Summary sheet (largest first) so you can see which names to add to the Config roster.", _
            vbInformation, "Low Roster Coverage"
    End If

    ' ---- Clean File B (skipped entirely if not provided) ----
    If hasFileB Then
        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- filtering FC Mode"
        If Not FilterFCModeIfPresent(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- keeping Missed FC rows"
        If Not KeepOnlyMissedFC(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- removing cancelled/planned"
        If Not DeleteCancelledOrPlanned(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- flagging EDVW discharges"
        FlagEDVWDischarges wsB
    End If

    ' ---- Build output ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Building output workbook"
    Dim outputOK As Boolean
    outputOK = BuildOutputWorkbook(wsA, wsB, roster, ncidPocList, _
        picker.MissedFCManualCount, inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, _
        waterfall, rosterCoverage, unmatchedNames, suppressTeamBlocks)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Done"

    ' ---- Cleanup: close input files ----
    On Error Resume Next
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    On Error GoTo 0

    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False

    If outputOK Then
        Dim msg As String
        msg = "FC Completion Report generated successfully." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
              "Duplicate encounters resolved: " & dupGroupsResolved & _
              " (" & dupRowsRemoved & " row(s) removed)" & vbNewLine & _
              "Voided/Deleted-only encounters (counted in denominator, REVERT B): " & voidedOnlyCount & vbNewLine & _
              "Encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter (e.g. Shopper-only): " & _
              encountersLostToModeFilter & vbNewLine & _
              "Inflight duplicate exception applied: " & inflightExceptionApplied & _
              " group(s); blocked by the priority<=2 guard: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " group(s)"
        If suppressTeamBlocks Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "Staff roster coverage: 0%% -- 'Who Closed the CCF' and numerator indicators were " & _
                  "suppressed this run."
            msg = Replace(msg, "0%%", "0%")
        Else
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "Staff roster coverage: " & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%")
        End If
        If Not hasFileB Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "File B was not provided -- Missed FC count used manual entry: " & _
                  picker.MissedFCManualCount
        End If
        MsgBox msg, vbInformation, "Complete"
    Else
        MsgBox "Report generation encountered an error. Check the output workbook " & _
               "(if open) for partial results.", vbExclamation, "Warning"
    End If

    Exit Sub

Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    Application.StatusBar = False
    On Error GoTo 0
    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    On Error GoTo 0
    MsgBox "Unexpected error:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
End Sub

Attribute VB_Name = "MainMacro"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' MainMacro.bas
'
' Entry point: GenerateFCCompletionReport (run via Alt+F8).
' Orchestrates the full pipeline:
'   1. FilePickerForm -- select File A (required) and File B (optional --
'      Decision 5, 2026-07-29 conflict resolution)
'   2. Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list from Config sheet
'   3. Clean File A (FC Mode filter, cancel filter, dedup)
'   4. Clean File B (FC Mode filter, Missed FC filter, cancel/planned, EDVW
'      flag) -- SKIPPED entirely if File B was not provided
'   5. Build output workbook (EM/EL split, Summary, Methodology, Roster Check)
'   6. Close input files, show success summary
'
' Step numbering is computed dynamically (stepNum/totalSteps) rather than
' hardcoded, so the progress bar adapts automatically to whether File B's
' four cleaning steps are present.
' ============================================================

Public Sub GenerateFCCompletionReport()

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    ' ---- Step 0: File picker ----
    Dim picker As FilePickerForm
    Set picker = New FilePickerForm
    If Not picker.ShowFilePicker Then Exit Sub

    Dim wbA As Workbook, wbB As Workbook
    Set wbA = picker.SelectedFileA
    Set wbB = picker.SelectedFileB

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (wbB Is Nothing)

    Dim wsA As Worksheet, wsB As Worksheet
    Set wsA = wbA.Sheets(1)
    If hasFileB Then Set wsB = wbB.Sheets(1)

    ' ---- Show progress (8 steps always + 4 more if File B is present) ----
    Dim totalSteps As Long
    totalSteps = 8
    If hasFileB Then totalSteps = totalSteps + 4
    ProgressForm.ShowProgress totalSteps

    Dim stepNum As Long
    stepNum = 0

    ' ---- Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Loading staff roster and NCID Point of Care list"
    Dim roster As Object
    Set roster = LoadStaffRoster()
    Dim ncidPocList As Object
    Set ncidPocList = LoadNCIDPointOfCareList()

    ' ---- Clean File A ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- filtering FC Mode"
    If Not FilterFCMode(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- removing cancelled admissions"
    If Not DeleteCancelledAdmissions(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    ' ---- Deduplicate File A ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- adding priority column"
    AddPriorityColumn wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- highlighting duplicate encounters"
    MarkDuplicateEncounters wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- resolving duplicates"
    Dim voidedOnlyCount As Long
    Dim dupGroupsResolved As Long
    Dim dupRowsRemoved As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionApplied As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionBlocked As Long
    If Not ResolveDuplicateEncounters(wsA, roster, voidedOnlyCount, _
            dupGroupsResolved, dupRowsRemoved, _
            inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked) Then GoTo Cleanup

    ' ---- Clean File B (skipped entirely if not provided) ----
    If hasFileB Then
        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- filtering FC Mode"
        If Not FilterFCModeIfPresent(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- keeping Missed FC rows"
        If Not KeepOnlyMissedFC(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- removing cancelled/planned"
        If Not DeleteCancelledOrPlanned(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- flagging EDVW discharges"
        FlagEDVWDischarges wsB
    End If

    ' ---- Build output ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Building output workbook"
    Dim outputOK As Boolean
    outputOK = BuildOutputWorkbook(wsA, wsB, roster, ncidPocList, voidedOnlyCount, _
        picker.MissedFCManualCount, inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Done"

    ' ---- Cleanup: close input files ----
    On Error Resume Next
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    On Error GoTo 0

    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False

    If outputOK Then
        Dim msg As String
        msg = "FC Completion Report generated successfully." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
              "Duplicate encounters resolved: " & dupGroupsResolved & _
              " (" & dupRowsRemoved & " row(s) removed)" & vbNewLine & _
              "Voided/Deleted-only encounters excluded: " & voidedOnlyCount & vbNewLine & _
              "Inflight duplicate exception applied: " & inflightExceptionApplied & _
              " group(s); blocked by the priority<=2 guard: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " group(s)"
        If Not hasFileB Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "File B was not provided -- Missed FC count used manual entry: " & _
                  picker.MissedFCManualCount
        End If
        MsgBox msg, vbInformation, "Complete"
    Else
        MsgBox "Report generation encountered an error. Check the output workbook " & _
               "(if open) for partial results.", vbExclamation, "Warning"
    End If

    Exit Sub

Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    Application.StatusBar = False
    On Error GoTo 0
    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    On Error GoTo 0
    MsgBox "Unexpected error:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"

1	Attribute VB_Name = "Helpers"
2	Option Explicit
3	
4	' ============================================================
5	' Helpers.bas
6	'
7	' Shared utilities for the FC Completion Report macro:
8	'   - Column lookup by header (tolerant of wrapped/whitespace headers)
9	'   - Text normalisation (en/em dash variants -- see NormalizeDashesAndSpaces)
10	'   - Input file validation (FilePickerForm)
11	'   - Staff roster (Config sheet): Staff Name -> Team lookup
12	'   - NCID EL Point of Care list (Config sheet): informational NCID Ward
13	'     breakdown only (2026-07-30 -- no longer gates the EL sheet, see
14	'     BuildOutput.bas Revert A)
15	'   - Row/encounter-count snapshots for the Summary sheet reconciliation
16	'     waterfall (CountDataRows, GetDistinctEncounterSet, CountKeysNotIn)
17	'   - Roster coverage guard (ComputeRosterCoverage) -- run before
18	'     BuildOutputWorkbook so an empty/unmatched roster is caught, not
19	'     silently reported as 100% "Others"
20	'   - SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare -- Alt+F8 bootstrap that suggests a
21	'     Staff Name -> Team roster from an FC Summary Report export
22	'   - ExportStaffRoster / ImportStaffRoster -- CSV round trip so the roster
23	'     survives the report's monthly hand-off between team leads
24	'
25	' Team names used throughout the macro (DeduplicateEncounters, BuildOutput):
26	'   ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others
27	' "Others" is the default for any staff name not listed in the Config sheet,
28	' so the macro runs correctly even before the roster is filled in.
29	' ============================================================
30	
31	Public Const TEAM_ED_EDFC As String = "ED/EDFC"
32	Public Const TEAM_INFLIGHT As String = "Inflight"
33	Public Const TEAM_NCID_AO As String = "NCID AO"
34	Public Const TEAM_ICH_PSO As String = "ICH PSO"
35	Public Const TEAM_ADMIN As String = "Admin/Managers"
36	Public Const TEAM_OTHERS As String = "Others"
37	
38	' ---- Column lookup -----------------------------------------
39	
40	' Searches row 1 of ws for a column whose header matches headerName.
41	' Matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant: line breaks
42	' (Alt+Enter / wrapped headers), non-breaking spaces, and runs of spaces
43	' are all normalised to a single space before comparison.
44	' Returns the 1-based column index, or 0 if not found.
45	Public Function FindColByHeader(ws As Worksheet, headerName As String) As Long
46	    Dim lastCol As Long
47	    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
48	
49	    Dim target As String
50	    target = NormHeader(headerName)
51	
52	    Dim c As Long
53	    For c = 1 To lastCol
54	        If NormHeader(CStr(ws.Cells(1, c).Value)) = target Then
55	            FindColByHeader = c
56	            Exit Function
57	        End If
58	    Next c
59	
60	    FindColByHeader = 0
61	End Function
62	
63	' Normalises a header string for tolerant comparison:
64	'   - converts line breaks (Chr 10 / 13) and non-breaking spaces (Chr 160) to spaces
65	'   - collapses any run of spaces to a single space
66	'   - trims ends and upper-cases
67	Public Function NormHeader(s As String) As String
68	    Dim t As String
69	    t = CStr(s)
70	    t = Replace(t, Chr(10), " ")
71	    t = Replace(t, Chr(13), " ")
72	    t = Replace(t, Chr(160), " ")
73	    t = Replace(t, vbTab, " ")
74	    Do While InStr(t, "  ") > 0
75	        t = Replace(t, "  ", " ")
76	    Loop
77	    NormHeader = UCase(Trim(t))
78	End Function
79	
80	' Encounter Number column is labelled differently across the two eFC exports:
81	'   - FC Summary Report (File A)         -> "Encounter Number"
82	'   - Inflight Missed FC Report (File B) -> "Encounter No"
83	' Try both spellings so the rest of the macro can use one column lookup.

91	' ---- Text normalisation (dash variants) -----------------------------------------
92	
93	' The "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" writes FC Mode as
94	' "Financial Counselling - AH" using an EN DASH (both in prose and in its
95	' sample data table), not a plain hyphen. If a real eFC export also uses an
96	' en dash (or an em dash), a straight ASCII-hyphen comparison would delete
97	' every row and the user would see "No Financial Counselling rows found".
98	' Normalises en dash (Chr(150) -- Windows-1252 -- and ChrW(8211) -- Unicode)
99	' and em dash (ChrW(8212)) to a plain "-", then collapses runs of spaces and
100	' trims. Run BOTH sides of every FC Mode / FC Status comparison through this.
101	Public Function NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(s As String) As String
102	    Dim t As String
103	    t = CStr(s)
104	    t = Replace(t, Chr(150), "-")     ' Windows-1252 en dash
105	    t = Replace(t, ChrW(8211), "-")   ' Unicode en dash
106	    t = Replace(t, ChrW(8212), "-")   ' Unicode em dash
107	    Do While InStr(t, "  ") > 0
108	        t = Replace(t, "  ", " ")
109	    Loop
110	    NormalizeDashesAndSpaces = Trim(t)
111	End Function

500	' ---- Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) --------------------------
501	
502	' Measures the fraction of File A encounters (post-cleaning, pre-dedup or
503	' post-dedup -- either works, since dedup keeps exactly one row per encounter)
504	' whose resolved CCF closer (Latest CCF Creation User, falling back to FC
505	' Created By per Q7) maps to a NAMED team rather than "Others". Call this
506	' after File A cleaning/dedup and before BuildOutputWorkbook so MainMacro can
507	' warn the user (or offer to abort) before an empty/unmatched roster silently
508	' produces a Summary claiming 100% of CCFs were closed by "Others".
509	'
510	' unmatchedNames is filled with distinct unmatched resolved-closer names ->
511	' row count, descending-sortable via SortDictDescending.
512	Public Function ComputeRosterCoverage(fileAws As Worksheet, roster As Object, _
513	        ByRef unmatchedNames As Object) As Double
514	
515	    Set unmatchedNames = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
516	    unmatchedNames.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
517	
518	    Dim encCol As Long, createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long
519	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
520	    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
521	    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
522	
523	    If encCol = 0 Then
524	        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
525	        Exit Function
526	    End If
527	
528	    Dim lastRow As Long
529	    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
530	    If lastRow < 2 Then
531	        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
532	        Exit Function
533	    End If
534	
535	    Dim cbData As Variant, lcData As Variant
536	    If createdByCol > 0 Then cbData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, createdByCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
537	    If latestCCFCol > 0 Then lcData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value
538	
539	    Dim total As Long, matched As Long
540	    Dim i As Long, nm As String, cbNm As String, lcNm As String
541	
542	    For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
543	        If createdByCol > 0 Then
544	            If lastRow = 2 Then cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData)) Else cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData(i, 1)))
545	        Else
546	            cbNm = ""
547	        End If
548	        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
549	            If lastRow = 2 Then lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData)) Else lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData(i, 1)))
550	        Else
551	            lcNm = ""
552	        End If
553	
554	        If lcNm <> "" Then
555	            nm = lcNm
556	        ElseIf cbNm <> "" Then
557	            nm = cbNm
558	        Else
559	            nm = ""
560	        End If
561	
562	        total = total + 1
563	        If nm <> "" Then
564	            If GetStaffTeam(roster, nm) <> TEAM_OTHERS Then
565	                matched = matched + 1
566	            Else
567	                Dim normNm As String
568	                normNm = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(nm)
569	                If unmatchedNames.Exists(normNm) Then
570	                    unmatchedNames(normNm) = unmatchedNames(normNm) + 1
571	                Else
572	                    unmatchedNames(normNm) = 1
573	                End If
574	            End If
575	        End If
576	    Next i
577	
578	    If total = 0 Then
579	        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
580	    Else
581	        ComputeRosterCoverage = matched / total
582	    End If
583	End Function
584	
585	' Returns the keys of a Dictionary(String -> Long) sorted by value descending,
586	' as a String array. Used everywhere an unmatched-name or suggestion list
587	' needs to show the biggest-impact entries first. VBA has no built-in sort,
588	' hence the manual insertion sort -- fine at the scale of a few hundred names.
589	Public Function SortDictKeysDescending(d As Object) As Variant
590	    Dim n As Long
591	    n = d.Count
592	    If n = 0 Then
593	        SortDictKeysDescending = Array()
594	        Exit Function
595	    End If
596	
597	    Dim keys() As String, counts() As Long
598	    ReDim keys(1 To n)
599	    ReDim counts(1 To n)
600	
601	    Dim k As Variant, idx As Long
602	    idx = 0
603	    For Each k In d.Keys
604	        idx = idx + 1
605	        keys(idx) = CStr(k)
606	        counts(idx) = CLng(d(k))
607	    Next k
608	
609	    Dim a As Long, b As Long, tmpS As String, tmpL As Long
610	    For a = 2 To n
611	        tmpS = keys(a): tmpL = counts(a)
612	        b = a - 1
613	        Do While b >= 1 And counts(b) < tmpL
614	            keys(b + 1) = keys(b)
615	            counts(b + 1) = counts(b)
616	            b = b - 1
617	        Loop
618	        keys(b + 1) = tmpS
619	        counts(b + 1) = tmpL
620	    Next a
621	
622	    SortDictKeysDescending = keys
623	End Function

1063	' Parses one CSV line into a 0-based String array, honouring double-quoted
1064	' fields (with "" as an escaped quote) so values like "LIM YONG CHIEW, DESMOND"
1065	' survive a round trip through ExportStaffRoster / ImportStaffRoster.
1066	Private Function ParseCSVLine(ln As String) As String()
1067	    Dim result() As String
1068	    Dim cap As Long
1069	    cap = 10
1070	    ReDim result(0 To cap - 1)
1071	    Dim count As Long
1072	    count = 0
1073	
1074	    Dim i As Long, ch As String, field As String, inQuotes As Boolean
1075	    inQuotes = False
1076	    field = ""
1077	    i = 1
1078	    Do While i <= Len(ln)
1079	        ch = Mid(ln, i, 1)
1080	        If inQuotes Then
1081	            If ch = """" Then
1082	                If i < Len(ln) And Mid(ln, i + 1, 1) = """" Then
1083	                    field = field & """"
1084	                    i = i + 1
1085	                Else
1086	                    inQuotes = False
1087	                End If
1088	            Else
1089	                field = field & ch
1090	            End If
1091	        Else
1092	            If ch = """" Then
1093	                inQuotes = True
1094	            ElseIf ch = "," Then
1095	                If count >= cap Then
1096	                    cap = cap * 2
1097	                    ReDim Preserve result(0 To cap - 1)
1098	                End If
1099	                result(count) = field
1100	                count = count + 1
1101	                field = ""
1102	            Else
1103	                field = field & ch
1104	            End If
1105	        End If
1106	        i = i + 1
1107	    Loop
1108	
1109	    If count >= cap Then
1110	        cap = cap + 1
1111	        ReDim Preserve result(0 To cap - 1)
1112	    End If
1113	    result(count) = field
1114	    count = count + 1
1115	
1116	    ReDim Preserve result(0 To count - 1)
1117	    ParseCSVLine = result
1118	End Function
