Attribute VB_Name = "Helpers"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' Helpers.bas
'
' Shared utilities for the FC Completion Report macro:
'   - Column lookup by header (tolerant of wrapped/whitespace headers)
'   - Text normalisation (en/em dash variants -- see NormalizeDashesAndSpaces)
'   - Input file validation (FilePickerForm)
'   - Staff roster (Config sheet): Staff Name -> Team lookup
'   - NCID EL Point of Care list (Config sheet): informational NCID Ward
'     breakdown only (2026-07-30 -- no longer gates the EL sheet, see
'     BuildOutput.bas Revert A)
'   - Row/encounter-count snapshots for the Summary sheet reconciliation
'     waterfall (CountDataRows, GetDistinctEncounterSet, CountKeysNotIn)
'   - Roster coverage guard (ComputeRosterCoverage) -- run before
'     BuildOutputWorkbook so an empty/unmatched roster is caught, not
'     silently reported as 100% "Others"
'   - SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare -- Alt+F8 bootstrap that suggests a
'     Staff Name -> Team roster from an FC Summary Report export
'   - ExportStaffRoster / ImportStaffRoster -- CSV round trip so the roster
'     survives the report's monthly hand-off between team leads
'
' Team names used throughout the macro (DeduplicateEncounters, BuildOutput):
'   ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others
' "Others" is the default for any staff name not listed in the Config sheet,
' so the macro runs correctly even before the roster is filled in.
' ============================================================

Public Const TEAM_ED_EDFC As String = "ED/EDFC"
Public Const TEAM_INFLIGHT As String = "Inflight"
Public Const TEAM_NCID_AO As String = "NCID AO"
Public Const TEAM_ICH_PSO As String = "ICH PSO"
Public Const TEAM_ADMIN As String = "Admin/Managers"
Public Const TEAM_OTHERS As String = "Others"

' ---- Column lookup -----------------------------------------

' Searches row 1 of ws for a column whose header matches headerName.
' Matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant: line breaks
' (Alt+Enter / wrapped headers), non-breaking spaces, and runs of spaces
' are all normalised to a single space before comparison.
' Returns the 1-based column index, or 0 if not found.
Public Function FindColByHeader(ws As Worksheet, headerName As String) As Long
    Dim lastCol As Long
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim target As String
    target = NormHeader(headerName)

    Dim c As Long
    For c = 1 To lastCol
        If NormHeader(CStr(ws.Cells(1, c).Value)) = target Then
            FindColByHeader = c
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next c

    FindColByHeader = 0
End Function

' Normalises a header string for tolerant comparison:
'   - converts line breaks (Chr 10 / 13) and non-breaking spaces (Chr 160) to spaces
'   - collapses any run of spaces to a single space
'   - trims ends and upper-cases
Public Function NormHeader(s As String) As String
    Dim t As String
    t = CStr(s)
    t = Replace(t, Chr(10), " ")
    t = Replace(t, Chr(13), " ")
    t = Replace(t, Chr(160), " ")
    t = Replace(t, vbTab, " ")
    Do While InStr(t, "  ") > 0
        t = Replace(t, "  ", " ")
    Loop
    NormHeader = UCase(Trim(t))
End Function

' Encounter Number column is labelled differently across the two eFC exports:
'   - FC Summary Report (File A)         -> "Encounter Number"
'   - Inflight Missed FC Report (File B) -> "Encounter No"
' Try both spellings so the rest of the macro can use one column lookup.
Public Function FindEncounterCol(ws As Worksheet) As Long
    Dim col As Long
    col = FindColByHeader(ws, "Encounter Number")
    If col = 0 Then col = FindColByHeader(ws, "Encounter No")
    FindEncounterCol = col
End Function

' ---- Text normalisation (dash variants) -----------------------------------------

' The "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" writes FC Mode as
' "Financial Counselling - AH" using an EN DASH (both in prose and in its
' sample data table), not a plain hyphen. If a real eFC export also uses an
' en dash (or an em dash), a straight ASCII-hyphen comparison would delete
' every row and the user would see "No Financial Counselling rows found".
' Normalises en dash (Chr(150) -- Windows-1252 -- and ChrW(8211) -- Unicode)
' and em dash (ChrW(8212)) to a plain "-", then collapses runs of spaces and
' trims. Run BOTH sides of every FC Mode / FC Status comparison through this.
Public Function NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(s As String) As String
    Dim t As String
    t = CStr(s)
    t = Replace(t, Chr(150), "-")     ' Windows-1252 en dash
    t = Replace(t, ChrW(8211), "-")   ' Unicode en dash
    t = Replace(t, ChrW(8212), "-")   ' Unicode em dash
    Do While InStr(t, "  ") > 0
        t = Replace(t, "  ", " ")
    Loop
    NormalizeDashesAndSpaces = Trim(t)
End Function

' ---- File validation (used by FilePickerForm) -----------------------------------------

' Validates that wb's first sheet has the critical columns for fileType.
'   "FC_SUMMARY"      -- File A, FC Summary Report
'   "INFLIGHT_MISSED" -- File B, Inflight Missed FC Report (Missed FC ticked)
Public Function ValidateFileHeaders(wb As Workbook, fileType As String) As Boolean
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(1)

    Dim isValid As Boolean
    isValid = False

    Select Case UCase(fileType)
        Case "FC_SUMMARY"
            ' Critical columns per CLAUDE.md: FC ID, Encounter Number, FC Status, FC Mode
            If FindColByHeader(ws, "FC ID") > 0 And _
               FindEncounterCol(ws) > 0 And _
               FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status") > 0 And _
               FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Mode") > 0 Then
                isValid = True
            End If

        Case "INFLIGHT_MISSED"
            ' Critical columns per CLAUDE.md: Encounter No, Missed FC, Admission Status
            If FindEncounterCol(ws) > 0 And _
               FindColByHeader(ws, "Missed FC") > 0 And _
               FindColByHeader(ws, "Admission Status") > 0 Then
                isValid = True
            End If
    End Select

    ValidateFileHeaders = isValid
End Function

' Returns True if File B's "Missed FC" column exists but is entirely blank --
' i.e. the export was taken without ticking the "Missed FC" indicator.
' FilePickerForm uses this to warn the user to re-export with the indicator
' ticked, or use the manual eFC dashboard workaround export (CLAUDE.md).
Public Function IsMissedFCColumnBlank(wb As Workbook) As Boolean
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(1)

    Dim missedCol As Long
    missedCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Missed FC")
    If missedCol = 0 Then
        IsMissedFCColumnBlank = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        IsMissedFCColumnBlank = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        IsMissedFCColumnBlank = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim data As Variant
    data = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, missedCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, missedCol)).Value

    Dim i As Long
    If lastRow = 2 Then
        ' Single-cell range comes back as a scalar, not a 2-D array
        IsMissedFCColumnBlank = (Trim(CStr(data)) = "")
        Exit Function
    End If

    For i = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
        If Trim(CStr(data(i, 1))) <> "" Then
            IsMissedFCColumnBlank = False
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i

    IsMissedFCColumnBlank = True
End Function

' Loads the Staff Name -> Team roster from the Config sheet into a Dictionary
' (keys are staff names, case-insensitive). Returns an empty Dictionary if the
' Config sheet doesn't exist yet or is missing its headers -- GetStaffTeam then
' defaults everyone to "Others", so the macro still runs correctly before the
' roster is filled in.
Public Function LoadStaffRoster() As Object
    Dim roster As Object
    Set roster = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    roster.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set LoadStaffRoster = roster
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim nameCol As Long, teamCol As Long
    nameCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Staff Name")
    teamCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Team")
    If nameCol = 0 Or teamCol = 0 Then
        Set LoadStaffRoster = roster
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, nameCol).End(xlUp).Row

    Dim i As Long
    Dim nm As String, tm As String
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        ' Run the roster key through NormalizeDashesAndSpaces (4.2, 2026-07-30):
        ' real eFC names carry stray double spaces / trailing whitespace, and a
        ' raw Trim() alone was letting those silently fall through to "Others".
        nm = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(ws.Cells(i, nameCol).Value))
        tm = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(i, teamCol).Value))
        If nm <> "" And tm <> "" Then roster(nm) = tm
    Next i

    Set LoadStaffRoster = roster
End Function

' Returns the team for a given staff name, looked up from the roster Dictionary
' returned by LoadStaffRoster. Defaults to "Others" if the name is blank, not
' found in the roster, or the roster is empty.
'
' Both the roster keys (LoadStaffRoster) and the lookup name here are run
' through NormalizeDashesAndSpaces before comparing (4.2, 2026-07-30) -- the
' roster.CompareMode = vbTextCompare already handles case, but not doubled/
' trailing whitespace, which real eFC display names do contain.
Public Function GetStaffTeam(roster As Object, staffName As String) As String
    Dim nm As String
    nm = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(staffName)

    If nm = "" Then
        GetStaffTeam = TEAM_OTHERS
    ElseIf roster.Exists(nm) Then
        GetStaffTeam = CStr(roster(nm))
    Else
        GetStaffTeam = TEAM_OTHERS
    End If
End Function

' Distinct Encounter Number values currently on ws, as a Dictionary (keys are
' encounter numbers, vbTextCompare; values unused). Used by MainMacro to
' measure how many distinct encounters vanish entirely across a filtering
' step (e.g. the Shopper-only encounters lost to the FC Mode filter, PART 2.4).
Public Function GetDistinctEncounterSet(ws As Worksheet) As Object
    Dim result As Object
    Set result = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    result.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        Set GetDistinctEncounterSet = result
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long

' Count of keys in setA that are NOT present in setB -- used to measure
' encounters lost entirely across a filtering step (PART 2.4 / PART 3.3).
Public Function CountKeysNotIn(setA As Object, setB As Object) As Long
    Dim n As Long
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In setA.Keys
        If Not setB.Exists(CStr(k)) Then n = n + 1
    Next k
    CountKeysNotIn = n
End Function

' ---- Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) --------------------------

' Measures the fraction of File A encounters (post-cleaning, pre-dedup or
' post-dedup -- either works, since dedup keeps exactly one row per encounter)
' whose resolved CCF closer (Latest CCF Creation User, falling back to FC
' Created By per Q7) maps to a NAMED team rather than "Others". Call this
' after File A cleaning/dedup and before BuildOutputWorkbook so MainMacro can
' warn the user (or offer to abort) before an empty/unmatched roster silently
' produces a Summary claiming 100% of CCFs were closed by "Others".
'
' unmatchedNames is filled with distinct unmatched resolved-closer names ->
' row count, descending-sortable via SortDictDescending.
Public Function ComputeRosterCoverage(fileAws As Worksheet, roster As Object, _
        ByRef unmatchedNames As Object) As Double

    Set unmatchedNames = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unmatchedNames.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim encCol As Long, createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")

    If encCol = 0 Then
        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim cbData As Variant, lcData As Variant
    If createdByCol > 0 Then cbData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, createdByCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
    If latestCCFCol > 0 Then lcData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value

    Dim total As Long, matched As Long
    Dim i As Long, nm As String, cbNm As String, lcNm As String

    For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
        If createdByCol > 0 Then
            If lastRow = 2 Then cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData)) Else cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData(i, 1)))
        Else
            cbNm = ""
        End If
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
            If lastRow = 2 Then lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData)) Else lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData(i, 1)))
        Else
            lcNm = ""
        End If

        If lcNm <> "" Then
            nm = lcNm
        ElseIf cbNm <> "" Then
            nm = cbNm
        Else
            nm = ""
        End If

        total = total + 1
        If nm <> "" Then
            If GetStaffTeam(roster, nm) <> TEAM_OTHERS Then
                matched = matched + 1
            Else
                Dim normNm As String
                normNm = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(nm)
                If unmatchedNames.Exists(normNm) Then
                    unmatchedNames(normNm) = unmatchedNames(normNm) + 1
                Else
                    unmatchedNames(normNm) = 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If total = 0 Then
        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
    Else
        ComputeRosterCoverage = matched / total
    End If
End Function

' Returns the keys of a Dictionary(String -> Long) sorted by value descending,
' as a String array. Used everywhere an unmatched-name or suggestion list
' needs to show the biggest-impact entries first. VBA has no built-in sort,
' hence the manual insertion sort -- fine at the scale of a few hundred names.
Public Function SortDictKeysDescending(d As Object) As Variant
    Dim n As Long
    n = d.Count
    If n = 0 Then
        SortDictKeysDescending = Array()
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim keys() As String, counts() As Long
    ReDim keys(1 To n)
    ReDim counts(1 To n)

    Dim k As Variant, idx As Long
    idx = 0
    For Each k In d.Keys
        idx = idx + 1
        keys(idx) = CStr(k)
        counts(idx) = CLng(d(k))
    Next k

    Dim a As Long, b As Long, tmpS As String, tmpL As Long
    For a = 2 To n
        tmpS = keys(a): tmpL = counts(a)
        b = a - 1
        Do While b >= 1 And counts(b) < tmpL
            keys(b + 1) = keys(b)
            counts(b + 1) = counts(b)
            b = b - 1
        Loop
        keys(b + 1) = tmpS
        counts(b + 1) = tmpL
    Next a

    SortDictKeysDescending = keys
End Function

' ---- SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare bootstrap (PART 4.3, 2026-07-30) ----------

' One-off bootstrap so a blank Config roster is never faced cold. Run via
' Alt+F8. Prompts for an FC Summary Report export, tallies Point Of Care per
' staff name (across BOTH "FC Created By" and "Latest CCF Creation User"),
' and writes suggestions to the Config sheet:
'   - A reference table in columns F:K (Staff Name | Rows | Dominant Point Of
'     Care | % Dominant | Suggested Team | Confidence), sorted by Rows
'     descending.
'   - Fills the main roster's Team column (B) ONLY where it is currently
'     blank -- an existing non-blank Team is NEVER overwritten. Staff names
'     not yet in the roster at all are appended as new rows with the
'     suggested team.
' Suggestions are a STARTING POINT only -- the team leads' own staff lists
' are authoritative.
Public Sub SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare()
    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFilePicker)
    fd.title = "Select FC Summary Report export for team suggestions"
    fd.Filters.Clear
    fd.Filters.Add "Excel Files", "*.xlsx; *.xlsm; *.xls"
    If fd.Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(fd.SelectedItems(1))
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(1)

    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long, pocCol As Long, encCol As Long
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Point of Care")
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    If pocCol = 0 Or (createdByCol = 0 And latestCCFCol = 0) Then
        MsgBox "Cannot suggest teams: this export is missing 'Point of Care' and/or both " & _
            "'FC Created By' / 'Latest CCF Creation User' columns.", vbExclamation, "Missing Columns"
        wb.Close SaveChanges:=False
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, pocCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If

    ' nameData(staffName) = Dictionary of pocValue -> count
    Dim nameData As Object
    Set nameData = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    nameData.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim i As Long
    Dim cbNm As String, lcNm As String, pocVal As String

    If lastRow >= 2 Then
        Dim cbData As Variant, lcData As Variant, pocData As Variant
        If createdByCol > 0 Then cbData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, createdByCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then lcData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value
        pocData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, pocCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, pocCol)).Value

        For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
            If lastRow = 2 Then
                pocVal = Trim(CStr(pocData))
            Else
                pocVal = Trim(CStr(pocData(i, 1)))
            End If

            If createdByCol > 0 Then
                If lastRow = 2 Then cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData)) Else cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData(i, 1)))
                If cbNm <> "" Then TallyStaffPOC nameData, cbNm, pocVal
            End If
            If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
                If lastRow = 2 Then lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData)) Else lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData(i, 1)))
                If lcNm <> "" Then TallyStaffPOC nameData, lcNm, pocVal
            End If
        Next i
    End If

    wb.Close SaveChanges:=False

    If nameData.Count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "No staff names found in the export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim cfg As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set cfg = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If cfg Is Nothing Then
        CreateConfigSheet
        Set cfg = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    End If

    ' Existing roster rows (normalised name -> row number), so suggestions
    ' merge into the roster instead of duplicating rows.
    Dim existingRow As Object
    Set existingRow = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    existingRow.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    Dim lastRosterRow As Long
    lastRosterRow = cfg.Cells(cfg.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    Dim r As Long, en As String
    For r = 2 To lastRosterRow
        en = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(cfg.Cells(r, 1).Value))
        If en <> "" Then existingRow(en) = r
    Next r

    ' Suggestion reference table headers (columns F:K)
    cfg.Cells(1, 6).Value = "Staff Name"
    cfg.Cells(1, 7).Value = "Rows"
    cfg.Cells(1, 8).Value = "Dominant Point Of Care"
    cfg.Cells(1, 9).Value = "% Dominant"
    cfg.Cells(1, 10).Value = "Suggested Team"
    cfg.Cells(1, 11).Value = "Confidence"
    With cfg.Range(cfg.Cells(1, 6), cfg.Cells(1, 11))
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 73, 125)
        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    On Error Resume Next
    cfg.Cells(1, 6).Comment.Delete
    On Error GoTo 0
    cfg.Cells(1, 6).AddComment "Suggestions from SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare (Alt+F8) -- a " & _
        "STARTING POINT only. Your team leads' own staff lists are authoritative -- always " & _
        "confirm before relying on these, especially anything flagged 'LOW -- please confirm'."

    Dim namesSorted As Variant
    namesSorted = SortDictKeysDescending(RowCountsFromNameData(nameData))

    Dim suggestedCounts As Object
    Set suggestedCounts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Dim lowCount As Long

    Dim outRow As Long
    outRow = 2
    Dim idx As Long
    For idx = LBound(namesSorted) To UBound(namesSorted)
        Dim staffName As String
        staffName = CStr(namesSorted(idx))
        Dim pocDict As Object
        Set pocDict = nameData(staffName)

        Dim domPoc As String, domCount As Long, totalCount As Long
        DominantPOC pocDict, domPoc, domCount, totalCount

        Dim pctDom As Double
        If totalCount > 0 Then pctDom = domCount / totalCount Else pctDom = 0

        Dim suggestedTeam As String
        suggestedTeam = SuggestTeamFromPOC(domPoc)

        Dim confidence As String
        If pctDom < 0.5 Then
            confidence = "LOW -- please confirm"
            lowCount = lowCount + 1
        Else
            confidence = "OK"
        End If

        cfg.Cells(outRow, 6).Value = staffName
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 7).Value = totalCount
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 8).Value = domPoc
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 9).Value = pctDom
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 9).NumberFormat = "0%"
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 10).Value = suggestedTeam
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 11).Value = confidence

        If suggestedCounts.Exists(suggestedTeam) Then
            suggestedCounts(suggestedTeam) = suggestedCounts(suggestedTeam) + 1
        Else
            suggestedCounts(suggestedTeam) = 1
        End If

        ' Fill roster Team column only if blank -- never overwrite an existing team.
        Dim normStaffName As String
        normStaffName = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(staffName)
        If existingRow.Exists(normStaffName) Then
            Dim rr As Long
            rr = existingRow(normStaffName)
            If Trim(CStr(cfg.Cells(rr, 2).Value)) = "" Then
                cfg.Cells(rr, 2).Value = suggestedTeam
            End If
        Else
            lastRosterRow = lastRosterRow + 1
            cfg.Cells(lastRosterRow, 1).Value = staffName
            cfg.Cells(lastRosterRow, 2).Value = suggestedTeam
            existingRow(normStaffName) = lastRosterRow
        End If

        outRow = outRow + 1
    Next idx

    cfg.Columns("A:K").AutoFit

    Dim summaryMsg As String
    summaryMsg = (UBound(namesSorted) - LBound(namesSorted) + 1) & " staff name(s) analysed." & vbNewLine
    Dim tk As Variant
    For Each tk In suggestedCounts.Keys
        summaryMsg = summaryMsg & "  " & CStr(tk) & ": " & suggestedCounts(tk) & vbNewLine
    Next tk
    summaryMsg = summaryMsg & vbNewLine & lowCount & " name(s) flagged LOW -- please confirm."

    MsgBox summaryMsg, vbInformation, "Team Suggestions Complete"
End Sub

' Builds a Dictionary(staffName -> total row count) from the nameData
' structure (staffName -> Dictionary(pocValue -> count)), for SortDictKeysDescending.
Private Function RowCountsFromNameData(nameData As Object) As Object
    Dim result As Object
    Set result = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    result.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In nameData.Keys
        result(CStr(k)) = SumDict(nameData(CStr(k)))
    Next k
    Set RowCountsFromNameData = result
End Function

Private Sub TallyStaffPOC(nameData As Object, staffName As String, pocVal As String)
    If Not nameData.Exists(staffName) Then
        Dim d As Object
        Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        d.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
        nameData.Add staffName, d
    End If
    Dim pd As Object
    Set pd = nameData(staffName)
    Dim key As String
    key = pocVal
    If key = "" Then key = "(blank)"
    If pd.Exists(key) Then
        pd(key) = pd(key) + 1
    Else
        pd(key) = 1
    End If
End Sub

Private Function SumDict(d As Object) As Long
    Dim total As Long
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In d.Keys
        total = total + d(k)
    Next k
    SumDict = total
End Function

Private Sub DominantPOC(pocDict As Object, ByRef domPoc As String, ByRef domCount As Long, ByRef totalCount As Long)
    domPoc = ""
    domCount = 0
    totalCount = 0
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In pocDict.Keys
        totalCount = totalCount + pocDict(k)
        If pocDict(k) > domCount Then
            domCount = pocDict(k)
            domPoc = CStr(k)
        End If
    Next k
End Function

Private Function SuggestTeamFromPOC(pocVal As String) As String
    Dim u As String
    u = UCase(Trim(pocVal))

    If u = "TTSH EMERGENCY" Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_ED_EDFC
    ElseIf u = "TTSH VIRTUAL WARD" Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_INFLIGHT
    ElseIf Left(u, Len("TTSH@HOME")) = "TTSH@HOME" Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_INFLIGHT
    ElseIf InStr(u, "NCID") > 0 Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_NCID_AO
    ElseIf Left(u, Len("ICH WARD")) = "ICH WARD" Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_ICH_PSO
    Else
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_OTHERS
    End If
End Function

' ---- Roster export / import (PART 4.4, 2026-07-30) -------------------------

' Writes the Config sheet's Staff Name / Team roster to a CSV via a SaveAs
' dialog, so the monthly-rotating report can carry one team's roster into
' the next lead's workbook copy without them drifting apart.
Public Sub ExportStaffRoster()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Config sheet does not exist yet. Run CreateConfigSheet (Alt+F8) first.", _
               vbExclamation, "No Config Sheet"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim nameCol As Long, teamCol As Long
    nameCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Staff Name")
    teamCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Team")
    If nameCol = 0 Or teamCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Config sheet is missing the 'Staff Name' / 'Team' headers.", vbExclamation, "Missing Columns"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, nameCol).End(xlUp).Row

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)
    fd.title = "Export Staff Roster"
    fd.InitialFileName = "FC_Staff_Roster.csv"
    If fd.Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim savePath As String
    savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)

    Dim fnum As Integer
    fnum = FreeFile
    Open savePath For Output As #fnum

    Print #fnum, "Staff Name,Team"

    Dim r As Long, nm As String, tm As String, count As Long
    For r = 2 To lastRow
        nm = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(r, nameCol).Value))
        tm = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(r, teamCol).Value))
        If nm <> "" Then
            Print #fnum, CSVQuote(nm) & "," & CSVQuote(tm)
            count = count + 1
        End If
    Next r

    Close #fnum

    Dim plural As String
    If count = 1 Then plural = "y" Else plural = "ies"
    MsgBox count & " staff roster entr" & plural & " exported to:" & vbNewLine & savePath, _
           vbInformation, "Export Complete"
End Sub

' Reads a Staff Name,Team CSV (as written by ExportStaffRoster) via an Open
' dialog, confirms with the user, then REPLACES the current Config roster.
' Quoted fields (e.g. "LIM YONG CHIEW, DESMOND") are parsed correctly.
Public Sub ImportStaffRoster()
    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFilePicker)
    fd.title = "Import Staff Roster"
    fd.Filters.Clear
    fd.Filters.Add "CSV Files", "*.csv"
    If fd.Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim filePath As String
    filePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)

    Dim fnum As Integer
    fnum = FreeFile
    Open filePath For Input As #fnum

    Dim lines As New Collection
    Dim ln As String
    Do While Not EOF(fnum)
        Line Input #fnum, ln
        lines.Add ln
    Loop
    Close #fnum

    If lines.Count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "The selected file is empty.", vbExclamation, "Empty File"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim resp As VbMsgBoxResult
    resp = MsgBox("This will REPLACE the current staff roster on the Config sheet with up to " & _
        (lines.Count - 1) & " row(s) from:" & vbNewLine & filePath & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
        "Continue?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Confirm Roster Import")
    If resp = vbNo Then Exit Sub

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        CreateConfigSheet
        Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow >= 2 Then ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, 2)).ClearContents

    Dim i As Long, outRow As Long, loaded As Long, malformed As Long
    outRow = 2
    For i = 1 To lines.Count
        Dim rawLine As String
        rawLine = CStr(lines(i))

        If i = 1 And UCase(Trim(rawLine)) = "STAFF NAME,TEAM" Then GoTo ContinueImportLoop

        Dim fields() As String
        fields = ParseCSVLine(rawLine)

        If (UBound(fields) - LBound(fields) + 1) <> 2 Then
            malformed = malformed + 1
        Else
            Dim nm As String, tm As String
            nm = Trim(fields(0))
            tm = Trim(fields(1))
            If nm = "" Then
                malformed = malformed + 1
            Else
                ws.Cells(outRow, 1).Value = nm
                ws.Cells(outRow, 2).Value = tm
                outRow = outRow + 1
                loaded = loaded + 1
            End If
        End If
ContinueImportLoop:
    Next i

    ws.Columns("A:B").AutoFit

    Dim plural As String
    If loaded = 1 Then plural = "y" Else plural = "ies"
    MsgBox loaded & " roster entr" & plural & " loaded; " & malformed & _
        " malformed row(s) skipped.", vbInformation, "Import Complete"
End Sub

' Quotes a CSV field if it contains a comma, quote, or line break; doubles any
' embedded quotes. Plain fields are left unquoted.
Private Function CSVQuote(s As String) As String
    If InStr(s, ",") > 0 Or InStr(s, """") > 0 Or InStr(s, vbCr) > 0 Or InStr(s, vbLf) > 0 Then
        CSVQuote = """" & Replace(s, """", """""") & """"
    Else
        CSVQuote = s
    End If
End Function

' Parses one CSV line into a 0-based String array, honouring double-quoted
' fields (with "" as an escaped quote) so values like "LIM YONG CHIEW, DESMOND"
' survive a round trip through ExportStaffRoster / ImportStaffRoster.
Private Function ParseCSVLine(ln As String) As String()
    Dim result() As String
    Dim cap As Long
    cap = 10
    ReDim result(0 To cap - 1)
    Dim count As Long
    count = 0

    Dim i As Long, ch As String, field As String, inQuotes As Boolean
    inQuotes = False
    field = ""
    i = 1
    Do While i <= Len(ln)
        ch = Mid(ln, i, 1)
        If inQuotes Then
            If ch = """" Then
                If i < Len(ln) And Mid(ln, i + 1, 1) = """" Then
                    field = field & """"
                    i = i + 1
                Else
                    inQuotes = False
                End If
            Else
                field = field & ch
            End If
        Else
            If ch = """" Then
                inQuotes = True
            ElseIf ch = "," Then
                If count >= cap Then
                    cap = cap * 2
                    ReDim Preserve result(0 To cap - 1)
                End If
                result(count) = field
                count = count + 1
                field = ""
            Else
                field = field & ch
            End If
        End If
        i = i + 1
    Loop

    If count >= cap Then
        cap = cap + 1
        ReDim Preserve result(0 To cap - 1)
    End If
    result(count) = field
    count = count + 1

    ReDim Preserve result(0 To count - 1)
    ParseCSVLine = result
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "MainMacro"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' MainMacro.bas
'
' Entry point: GenerateFCCompletionReport (run via Alt+F8).
' Orchestrates the full pipeline:
'   1. FilePickerForm -- select File A (required) and File B (optional)
'   2. Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list from Config sheet
'   3. Clean File A (FC Mode filter, cancel filter, dedup), snapshotting row/
'      encounter counts along the way for the Summary sheet reconciliation
'      waterfall (PART 3.3, 2026-07-30)
'   4. Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) -- measures what fraction
'      of encounters map to a named team; warns or aborts before an empty/
'      unmatched roster silently reports 100% "Others"
'   5. Clean File B (FC Mode filter, Missed FC filter, cancel/planned, EDVW
'      flag) -- SKIPPED entirely if File B was not provided
'   6. Build output workbook (EM/EL split, Summary, Methodology, Roster Check)
'   7. Close input files, show success summary
'
' Step numbering is computed dynamically (stepNum/totalSteps) rather than
' hardcoded, so the progress bar adapts automatically to whether File B's
' four cleaning steps are present.
' ============================================================

Public Sub GenerateFCCompletionReport()

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    ' ---- Step 0: File picker ----
    Dim picker As FilePickerForm
    Set picker = New FilePickerForm
    If Not picker.ShowFilePicker Then Exit Sub

    Dim wbA As Workbook, wbB As Workbook
    Set wbA = picker.SelectedFileA
    Set wbB = picker.SelectedFileB

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (wbB Is Nothing)

    Dim wsA As Worksheet, wsB As Worksheet
    Set wsA = wbA.Sheets(1)
    If hasFileB Then Set wsB = wbB.Sheets(1)

    ' ---- Show progress (9 steps always + 4 more if File B is present) ----
    Dim totalSteps As Long
    totalSteps = 9
    If hasFileB Then totalSteps = totalSteps + 4
    ProgressForm.ShowProgress totalSteps

    Dim stepNum As Long
    stepNum = 0

    ' ---- Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Loading staff roster and NCID Point of Care list"
    Dim roster As Object
    Set roster = LoadStaffRoster()
    Dim ncidPocList As Object
    Set ncidPocList = LoadNCIDPointOfCareList()

    ' ---- Clean File A ----
    ' Waterfall snapshot: rows as loaded + distinct encounters before the FC
    ' Mode filter (PART 2.4 / 3.3, 2026-07-30).
    Dim rowsLoadedA As Long
    rowsLoadedA = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim encSetBeforeMode As Object
    Set encSetBeforeMode = GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- filtering FC Mode"
    If Not FilterFCMode(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    Dim rowsAfterMode As Long
    rowsAfterMode = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim encountersLostToModeFilter As Long
    encountersLostToModeFilter = CountKeysNotIn(encSetBeforeMode, GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA))

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- removing cancelled admissions"
    If Not DeleteCancelledAdmissions(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    Dim rowsAfterCancelled As Long
    rowsAfterCancelled = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup As Long
    uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup = GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA).Count

    ' ---- Deduplicate File A ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- adding priority column"
    AddPriorityColumn wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- highlighting duplicate encounters"
    MarkDuplicateEncounters wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- resolving duplicates"
    Dim voidedOnlyCount As Long
    Dim dupGroupsResolved As Long
    Dim dupRowsRemoved As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionApplied As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionBlocked As Long
    If Not ResolveDuplicateEncounters(wsA, roster, voidedOnlyCount, _
            dupGroupsResolved, dupRowsRemoved, _
            inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked) Then GoTo Cleanup

    ' ---- Waterfall dictionary (PART 3.3) -- consumed by BuildOutput.bas's
    ' WriteReconciliationWaterfall on the Summary sheet.
    Dim waterfall As Object
    Set waterfall = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    waterfall("RowsLoaded") = rowsLoadedA
    waterfall("RowsAfterModeFilter") = rowsAfterMode
    waterfall("RowsAfterCancelledFilter") = rowsAfterCancelled
    waterfall("UniqueEncounters") = uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup
    waterfall("DuplicateGroupsResolved") = dupGroupsResolved
    waterfall("DuplicateRowsRemoved") = dupRowsRemoved
    waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter") = encountersLostToModeFilter

    ' ---- Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) ----
    ' Run after File A cleaning/dedup, before BuildOutputWorkbook, so an
    ' empty/unmatched roster is caught here rather than silently producing a
    ' Summary claiming 100% of CCFs were closed by "Others".
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Checking staff roster coverage"
    Dim unmatchedNames As Object
    Dim rosterCoverage As Double
    rosterCoverage = ComputeRosterCoverage(wsA, roster, unmatchedNames)

    Dim suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean
    suppressTeamBlocks = False

    If rosterCoverage = 0 Then
        Dim resp As VbMsgBoxResult
        resp = MsgBox("The staff roster (Config sheet) is empty, or doesn't match any names in " & _
            "this export." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "'Who Closed the CCF' and all four numerator indicators (FC created by EDFC, CCF " & _
            "closed by EDFC/Inflight/NCID AO) will be UNAVAILABLE for this report." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "Continue and produce completion statistics only?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, _
            "Staff Roster Not Matched")
        If resp = vbNo Then GoTo Cleanup
        suppressTeamBlocks = True
    ElseIf rosterCoverage < 0.7 Then
        MsgBox "Staff roster coverage is low: only " & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%") & _
            " of encounters matched a named team." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "The report will still be produced, but unmatched staff names will be listed on the " & _
            "Summary sheet (largest first) so you can see which names to add to the Config roster.", _
            vbInformation, "Low Roster Coverage"
    End If

    ' ---- Clean File B (skipped entirely if not provided) ----
    If hasFileB Then
        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- filtering FC Mode"
        If Not FilterFCModeIfPresent(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- keeping Missed FC rows"
        If Not KeepOnlyMissedFC(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- removing cancelled/planned"
        If Not DeleteCancelledOrPlanned(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- flagging EDVW discharges"
        FlagEDVWDischarges wsB
    End If

    ' ---- Build output ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Building output workbook"
    Dim outputOK As Boolean
    outputOK = BuildOutputWorkbook(wsA, wsB, roster, ncidPocList, _
        picker.MissedFCManualCount, inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, _
        waterfall, rosterCoverage, unmatchedNames, suppressTeamBlocks)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Done"

    ' ---- Cleanup: close input files ----
    On Error Resume Next
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    On Error GoTo 0

    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False

    If outputOK Then
        Dim msg As String
        msg = "FC Completion Report generated successfully." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
              "Duplicate encounters resolved: " & dupGroupsResolved & _
              " (" & dupRowsRemoved & " row(s) removed)" & vbNewLine & _
              "Voided/Deleted-only encounters (counted in denominator, REVERT B): " & voidedOnlyCount & vbNewLine & _
              "Encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter (e.g. Shopper-only): " & _
              encountersLostToModeFilter & vbNewLine & _
              "Inflight duplicate exception applied: " & inflightExceptionApplied & _
              " group(s); blocked by the priority<=2 guard: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " group(s)"
        If suppressTeamBlocks Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "Staff roster coverage: 0% -- 'Who Closed the CCF' and numerator indicators were " & _
                  "suppressed this run."
        Else
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "Staff roster coverage: " & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%")
        End If
        If Not hasFileB Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "File B was not provided -- Missed FC count used manual entry: " & _
                  picker.MissedFCManualCount
        End If
        MsgBox msg, vbInformation, "Complete"
    Else
        MsgBox "Report generation encountered an error. Check the output workbook " & _
               "(if open) for partial results.", vbExclamation, "Warning"
    End If

    Exit Sub

Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    Application.StatusBar = False
    On Error GoTo 0
    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    On Error GoTo 0
    MsgBox "Unexpected error:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
End Sub

import openpyxl
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook("FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx", read_only=True, data_only=True)
ws = wb[wb.sheetnames[0]]
rows = ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, values_only=True)
headers = next(rows)
idx = {h: i for i, h in enumerate(headers)}

def norm_dash(s):
    if s is None: return ""
    s = str(s)
    s = s.replace("\u2013","-").replace("\u2014","-").replace(chr(150), "-")
    while "  " in s: s = s.replace("  "," ")
    return s.strip()

FC_MODE_AH = "financial counselling - ah"
FC_MODE_DOWNTIME = "financial counselling - downtime"

def priority(status):
    s = norm_dash(status).upper()
    if "VOID" in s or "DELET" in s:
        return 99
    table = {
        "COMPLETED": 1,
        "ACKNOWLEDGEMENT BY OTHER MEANS": 2,
        "ATTEMPTED - VIRTUAL FC COMPLETED, PENDING SIGNATURE": 3,
        "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT/NOK DECLINES TO SIGN": 4,
        "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT IS UNABLE TO SIGN": 5,
        "ATTEMPTED - UNABLE TO COMPLETE": 6,
    }
    return table.get(s, 98)

all_rows = list(rows)
print("Total data rows:", len(all_rows))

admStatusCounter = Counter()
kept_mode = []
mode_excluded_encounters = set()
all_encounters = set()

for r in all_rows:
    enc = str(r[idx['Encounter No']]).strip()
    all_encounters.add(enc)
    mode = norm_dash(r[idx['FC Mode']]).upper()
    admStatusCounter[r[idx['Admission Status']]] += 1
    if mode == FC_MODE_AH.upper() or mode == FC_MODE_DOWNTIME.upper():
        kept_mode.append(r)

print("Rows after mode filter:", len(kept_mode))
kept_mode_encounters = set(str(r[idx['Encounter No']]).strip() for r in kept_mode)
mode_lost = all_encounters - kept_mode_encounters
print("Encounters lost to mode filter:", len(mode_lost), mode_lost)

print("\nAdmission Status distinct:", admStatusCounter)

# cancelled filter
kept_cancel = [r for r in kept_mode if str(r[idx['Admission Status']]).strip().upper() != "CANCELLED"]
print("\nRows after cancelled filter:", len(kept_cancel))

# unique encounters
uniq_enc = set(str(r[idx['Encounter No']]).strip() for r in kept_cancel)
print("Unique encounters:", len(uniq_enc))

# group by encounter
groups = defaultdict(list)
for r in kept_cancel:
    enc = str(r[idx['Encounter No']]).strip()
    groups[enc].append(r)

dup_groups = {k:v for k,v in groups.items() if len(v) > 1}
print("Duplicate groups:", len(dup_groups))
dup_rows_removed = sum(len(v)-1 for v in dup_groups.values())
print("Duplicate rows removed:", dup_rows_removed)

# plain winner per group (no Inflight exception)
winners = {}
for enc, grp in groups.items():
    best = None
    for r in grp:
        pri = priority(r[idx['FC Status']])
        fcid = r[idx['FC ID']]
        try:
            fcid_val = float(fcid)
        except:
            fcid_val = fcid
        if best is None:
            best = (pri, fcid_val, r)
        else:
            bpri, bfcid, br = best
            if pri < bpri:
                best = (pri, fcid_val, r)
            elif pri == bpri:
                try:
                    if fcid_val > bfcid:
                        best = (pri, fcid_val, r)
                except:
                    pass
    winners[enc] = best[2]

print("Winners count:", len(winners))

em = 0; el = 0; other = 0
voided_em = 0; voided_el = 0
for enc, r in winners.items():
    admtype = str(r[idx['Admission Type']]).strip().upper()
    pri = priority(r[idx['FC Status']])
    if admtype == "EMERGENCY":
        em += 1
        if pri == 99: voided_em += 1
    elif admtype.startswith("ELECTIVE INPA"):
        el += 1
        if pri == 99: voided_el += 1
    else:
        other += 1

print("\nEM:", em, "EL:", el, "other:", other)
print("Voided EM:", voided_em, "Voided EL:", voided_el, "total voided:", voided_em+voided_el)

# unrecognised statuses (priority 98, not containing DRAFT)
unrec = Counter()
for enc, r in winners.items():
    pri = priority(r[idx['FC Status']])
    if pri == 98:
        s = str(r[idx['FC Status']]) if r[idx['FC Status']] else "(blank)"
        if "DRAFT" not in s.upper():
            unrec[s]+=1
print("\nUnrecognised (non-Draft) priority-98 statuses among winners:", unrec)
EOF

content.text: I found a subtle issue in my simulation: both Shopper-mode rows have a **blank** Encounter No, and my `GetDistinctEncounterSet` deliberately excludes blank keys — so the diff-based "encounters lost to mode filter" would compute 0, not the validated 1. Let me add a dedicated check for this:

input.old_string:
' Count of keys in setA that are NOT present in setB -- used to measure
' encounters lost entirely across a filtering step (PART 2.4 / PART 3.3).
Public Function CountKeysNotIn(setA As Object, setB As Object) As Long
    Dim n As Long
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In setA.Keys
        If Not setB.Exists(CStr(k)) Then n = n + 1
    Next k
    CountKeysNotIn = n
End Function
input.new_string:
' Count of keys in setA that are NOT present in setB -- used to measure
' encounters lost entirely across a filtering step (PART 2.4 / PART 3.3).
' NOTE: GetDistinctEncounterSet skips blank Encounter Number values, so a row
' with a blank encounter number is invisible to this diff -- see
' CountBlankEncounterRows for why that matters for the FC Mode filter.
Public Function CountKeysNotIn(setA As Object, setB As Object) As Long
    Dim n As Long
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In setA.Keys
        If Not setB.Exists(CStr(k)) Then n = n + 1
    Next k
    CountKeysNotIn = n
End Function

' Number of data rows on ws whose Encounter Number is blank. Real eFC exports
' have at least one FC Mode (e.g. Shopper) that is submitted with NO
' Encounter Number at all -- such rows are invisible to
' GetDistinctEncounterSet/CountKeysNotIn (which key on Encounter Number), so
' MainMacro uses this alongside that diff to detect "the FC Mode filter
' dropped a blank-encounter row" without overcounting: since a blank
' encounter number can't be disambiguated into separate real encounters, all
' such rows lost to a filter are counted as at most ONE "encounter" (see
' MainMacro's encountersLostToModeFilter calculation, PART 2.4/3.3).
Public Function CountBlankEncounterRows(ws As Worksheet) As Long
    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        CountBlankEncounterRows = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        CountBlankEncounterRows = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim data As Variant
    data = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, encCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, encCol)).Value

    Dim i As Long, n As Long
    If lastRow = 2 Then
        If Trim(CStr(data)) = "" Then n = 1
    Else
        For i = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
            If Trim(CStr(data(i, 1))) = "" Then n = n + 1
        Next i
    End If

    CountBlankEncounterRows = n
End Function

1	# FC Completion Report -- Process Flow (For Review)
2	
3	This document describes how the new FC Completion Report tool will process the
4	monthly eFC exports and calculate the completion statistics. Please read through
5	and confirm whether the rules below match how the report should actually work --
6	specific questions are listed at the end.
7	
8	> **2026-07-29 conflict resolution note:** this document had silently diverged
9	> from "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" (the authoritative
10	> source) by the time Q1-Q8 below were confirmed on 2026-06-18. Two of those
11	> answers were revisited and revised against the guide: **Q1** (EM/EL split)
12	> now requires the Point of Care condition the guide always specified, and
13	> **Q3** (Inflight duplicate exception) was narrowed to match the guide's
14	> intent rather than the broader rule this document previously described. See
15	> the updated Section 2 steps 6 and 9, the priority table, and Section 5A
16	> below -- these now match the guide and the shipped code.
17	
18	---
19	
20	## 1. Inputs
21	
22	Two eFC exports are used:
23	
24	- **File A -- FC Summary Report**: one row per FC ID, full month, Admission Type
25	  Emergency (+ Elective Inpatient for NCID AO).
26	- **File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report** (OPTIONAL): Inflight FC Report with the
27	  "Missed FC" indicator ticked. If File B is not provided, the tool asks for a
28	  manual Missed FC count instead (the eFC dashboard workaround the guide
29	  documents), attributed entirely to Emergency (EM) since the dashboard
30	  workaround doesn't distinguish Elective/NCID AO missed cases.
31	
32	---
33	
34	## 2. File A -- Cleaning and Deduplication
35	
36	The tool processes File A in this order:
37	
38	1. **Remove non-FC rows.** Keep only rows where FC Mode is "Financial Counselling -
39	   AH" or "Financial Counselling - Downtime". (Removes Shopper-mode and other
40	   irrelevant rows.)
41	
42	2. **Remove cancelled admissions.** Any row where Admission Status = "Cancelled" is
43	   dropped.
44	
45	3. **Rank each remaining row by FC Status**, using this priority order (1 = best,
46	   higher number = worse):
47	
48	   | Priority | FC Status |
49	   |---|---|
50	   | 1 | Completed |
51	   | 2 | Acknowledgement by other means |
52	   | 3 | Attempted - Virtual FC Completed, pending signature |
53	   | 4 | Attempted - patient/NOK declines to sign |
54	   | 5 | Attempted - Patient is unable to sign |
55	   | 6 | Attempted - unable to complete |
56	   | 98 | Anything else not explicitly listed above -- Draft variants, blanks, typos, new eFC statuses. Still IN the denominator (not completed), NOT excluded. |
57	   | 99 | Voided / Deleted ONLY (matched by substring, e.g. "Voided", "Deleted by Admin") -- excluded from the denominator entirely (see step 8). |
58	
59	   The distinct FC Status text values landing on priority 98 are collected and
60	   printed as a warning block on the Summary sheet each run, so a typo or a
61	   brand-new eFC status is visible instead of silently shrinking the
62	   denominator.
63	
64	4. **Group rows by Encounter Number** and sort each group so the most recently
65	   created CCF is last.
66	
67	5. **Highlight duplicate encounter numbers in red** -- this is just a visual aid so
68	   staff can see at a glance which encounters had more than one FC ID.
69	
70	6. **Pick one row to keep per encounter.** For each encounter with more than one FC
71	   ID:
72	   - The default rule is **plain lowest-priority-wins**: across ALL candidate rows,
73	     keep the one with the best (lowest) priority number from the table above. If
74	     there's a tie, keep the one with the **larger FC ID** (i.e. the more recently
75	     created one).
76	   - The **Inflight exception** only overrides this default when BOTH hold:
77	     a) at least one of the *non*-Inflight rows in the group was created by an
78	        **ED/EDFC** staff member (per the staff roster), AND
79	     b) the winner that would result from setting the Inflight row(s) aside has
80	        priority 1 or 2 (Completed / Acknowledgement by other means).
81	     When both hold, the Inflight-created row(s) are set aside and the winner is
82	     picked from the remaining non-Inflight candidates instead. If either
83	     condition fails, the plain lowest-priority rule from above stands -- the
84	     Inflight row is treated like any other candidate.
85	   - If an encounter only has one FC ID to begin with, that row is always kept
86	     (even if its priority is 99).
87	   - The tool counts how many encounter groups used the Inflight exception, and
88	     how many were blocked by the priority<=2 guard (fell back to the plain

# FC Completion Report -- Process Flow (For Review)

This document describes how the new FC Completion Report tool will process the
monthly eFC exports and calculate the completion statistics. Please read through
and confirm whether the rules below match how the report should actually work --
specific questions are listed at the end.

> **2026-07-29 conflict resolution note:** this document had silently diverged
> from "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" (the authoritative
> source) by the time Q1-Q8 below were confirmed on 2026-06-18. Two of those
> answers were revisited and revised against the guide: **Q1** (EM/EL split)
> now requires the Point of Care condition the guide always specified, and
> **Q3** (Inflight duplicate exception) was narrowed to match the guide's
> intent rather than the broader rule this document previously described. See
> the updated Section 2 steps 6 and 9, the priority table, and Section 5A
> below -- these now match the guide and the shipped code.

---

## 1. Inputs

Two eFC exports are used:

- **File A -- FC Summary Report**: one row per FC ID, full month, Admission Type
  Emergency (+ Elective Inpatient for NCID AO).
- **File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report** (OPTIONAL): Inflight FC Report with the
  "Missed FC" indicator ticked. If File B is not provided, the tool asks for a
  manual Missed FC count instead (the eFC dashboard workaround the guide
  documents), attributed entirely to Emergency (EM) since the dashboard
  workaround doesn't distinguish Elective/NCID AO missed cases.

---

## 2. File A -- Cleaning and Deduplication

The tool processes File A in this order:

1. **Remove non-FC rows.** Keep only rows where FC Mode is "Financial Counselling -
   AH" or "Financial Counselling - Downtime". (Removes Shopper-mode and other
   irrelevant rows.)

2. **Remove cancelled admissions.** Any row where Admission Status = "Cancelled" is
   dropped.

3. **Rank each remaining row by FC Status**, using this priority order (1 = best,
   higher number = worse):

   | Priority | FC Status |
   |---|---|
   | 1 | Completed |
   | 2 | Acknowledgement by other means |
   | 3 | Attempted - Virtual FC Completed, pending signature |
   | 4 | Attempted - patient/NOK declines to sign |
   | 5 | Attempted - Patient is unable to sign |
   | 6 | Attempted - unable to complete |
   | 98 | Anything else not explicitly listed above -- Draft variants, blanks, typos, new eFC statuses. Still IN the denominator (not completed), NOT excluded. |
   | 99 | Voided / Deleted ONLY (matched by substring, e.g. "Voided", "Deleted by Admin") -- excluded from the denominator entirely (see step 8). |

   The distinct FC Status text values landing on priority 98 are collected and
   printed as a warning block on the Summary sheet each run, so a typo or a
   brand-new eFC status is visible instead of silently shrinking the
   denominator.

4. **Group rows by Encounter Number** and sort each group so the most recently
   created CCF is last.

5. **Highlight duplicate encounter numbers in red** -- this is just a visual aid so
   staff can see at a glance which encounters had more than one FC ID.

6. **Pick one row to keep per encounter.** For each encounter with more than one FC
   ID:
   - The default rule is **plain lowest-priority-wins**: across ALL candidate rows,
     keep the one with the best (lowest) priority number from the table above. If
     there's a tie, keep the one with the **larger FC ID** (i.e. the more recently
     created one).
   - The **Inflight exception** only overrides this default when BOTH hold:
     a) at least one of the *non*-Inflight rows in the group was created by an
        **ED/EDFC** staff member (per the staff roster), AND
     b) the winner that would result from setting the Inflight row(s) aside has
        priority 1 or 2 (Completed / Acknowledgement by other means).
     When both hold, the Inflight-created row(s) are set aside and the winner is
     picked from the remaining non-Inflight candidates instead. If either
     condition fails, the plain lowest-priority rule from above stands -- the
     Inflight row is treated like any other candidate.
   - If an encounter only has one FC ID to begin with, that row is always kept
     (even if its priority is 99).
   - The tool counts how many encounter groups used the Inflight exception, and
     how many were blocked by the priority<=2 guard (fell back to the plain
     rule) -- both counts are reported in the final summary dialog and on the
     Methodology sheet.

7. **Delete every row that wasn't kept.** This replaces the old manual "review
   duplicates and delete" step entirely -- the tool does it automatically using the
   rule above.

8. **Encounters where the only FC ID was Voided/Deleted (priority 99)** are removed
   from the count entirely (not counted as completed, not counted as missed). The
   tool reports how many of these there were, so staff can double-check whether an FC
   is still needed for those encounters.

9. **Split the remaining rows into two sheets, based on Admission Type AND
   (for Elective) Point of Care:**
   - **Emergency** admissions -> "EM" sheet.
   - **Elective Inpatient** admissions go to the "EL" sheet ONLY if their Point
     of Care is one of the configured NCID ward E/F values (a Config-sheet
     list, editable without touching code). This matters because without it,
     the EL denominator would be every elective inpatient admission
     hospital-wide, while the numerator is only NCID AO's own work.
   - Elective Inpatient rows whose Point of Care is NOT in that list are set
     aside and reported separately (not silently dropped) -- they go into
     neither EM nor EL.
   - If the NCID Point of Care list hasn't been filled in yet (ships empty),
     the tool does NOT guess: it skips the EL sheet and all EL statistics
     entirely, shows a warning, and says so clearly on the Summary and
     Methodology sheets. EM is still produced normally in that case.
   - Any row that is neither Emergency nor Elective Inpatient (shouldn't
     normally happen, given the export filters) is set aside and reported
     separately so nothing silently disappears.
   - As an extra check (informational only, doesn't change which sheet a row goes
     to), the tool flags rows where the bucket "looks wrong" -- e.g. an Emergency
     row that was actually closed by an NCID AO staff member, or an Elective row
     closed by ED/EDFC or Inflight staff. This is just a flag for staff to review.

---

## 3. File B -- Cleaning (Missed FC List) -- OPTIONAL

Missed FC count (the eFC dashboard workaround) instead, and skips steps 1-3
below entirely -- everything after this section that reads "the missed FC
count" uses the manual entry, attributed to Emergency (EM), when File B is
absent.

1. **Keep only rows where "Missed FC" = Yes.**

2. **Remove Cancelled and Planned admissions** (Cancelled = upstream cancellation;
   Planned = patient never actually admitted).

3. **Flag EDVW discharges** (Point Of Care = "TTSH Virtual Ward" and Accommodation
   Code = "EDVW") with an informational column -- these are still counted as missed
   FC like everything else, just labelled so staff can see how many are EDVW cases.

4. **Everything left over = genuinely missed FC.** This becomes the follow-up list
   for EDFC/Inflight/NCID AO, and each row counts toward the "Missed FC" total.

---

## 4. Staff Roster and NCID Point of Care (Config)

Two independent editable lists live on the Config sheet:

- **Staff Name -> Team** -- where Team is one of: ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO,
  ICH PSO, Admin/Managers. Anyone not on the list is treated as "Others" (e.g.
  SOC staff). Used in three places:
  - Step 6 above (deciding which duplicate row to keep -- the Inflight exception).
  - The EM/EL "looks wrong" flag in Step 9 above.
  - The "who closed the CCF" percentage breakdown (Section 5 below).

- **NCID EL Point of Care** -- the exact Point of Care ward text values (NCID
  wards E and F) that gate the EL split (Step 9 above). Ships empty; must be
  filled in from a real export before EL statistics will be computed.

---

## 5. How the Numbers Are Calculated

**Denominator** (total encounters counted) = (encounters kept after File A
deduplication, excluding voided/deleted-only, priority 99) + (genuinely missed
FC count, from File B or manual entry -- Section 3).

**A. Completion status breakdown** (counts and % of denominator) -- five bands,
plus a "Not completed (total)" subtotal so the old single headline figure is
still available:

| Colour | Meaning | Based on priority |
|---|---|---|
| Green | FC Completed with written acknowledgement | 1, 2 |
| Pink | CCF explained but not signed | 3 |
| Light Green | Attempted, no further follow-up | 4, 5 |
| Orange | FC not completed | 6 |
| White/none | Draft only -- no FC outcome | 98 |
| Grey | Missed FC -- no FC ID created | File B / manual entry |

"Not completed (total)" = Orange + White/none + Grey. Splitting Drafts
(priority 98) into their own band does not change this total or the overall
completion percentage -- only the presentation. Each Summary block also shows
a visible "Total" row so a mismatch between the bands and the denominator
would be obvious.

**B. Who closed the CCF** -- each File A encounter is categorized by the team of
whoever has "Latest CCF Creation User" (using the staff roster). If that field is
blank (i.e. no CCF was ever generated -- pure Draft), the tool falls back to "FC
Created By" instead, so the encounter is still credited to *some* team rather than
disappearing from this breakdown. File B's missed-FC count becomes its own "CCF not
generated" bucket.

**C. Numerator detail table** (counts used for team workload reporting):

| Metric | Based on | Team |
|---|---|---|
| FC completed by EDFC (initial) | FC Created By | ED/EDFC |
| FC completed by EDFC (full CCF) | Latest CCF Creation User | ED/EDFC |
| FC completed by Inflight | Latest CCF Creation User | Inflight |
| FC completed by NCID AO | Latest CCF Creation User | NCID AO |

**General principle:** when a case is ambiguous or borderline, the tool counts it as
**not completed / missed** rather than completed. The idea is that it's better to
slightly overstate outstanding work than to understate it.

All of A, B, and C above are calculated three times: once for Emergency, once for
Elective/NCID AO, and once combined.

---

## 6. What You'll Get (Output File)

A new Excel workbook with:

1. **EM sheet** -- cleaned, deduplicated Emergency encounters (one row per encounter). Always produced.
2. **EL sheet** -- same, for Elective/NCID AO encounters (Point of Care matched
   the NCID list). SKIPPED if the NCID Point of Care list is empty (Section 2,
   step 9).
3. **Missed FC sheet** -- the follow-up list from File B. SKIPPED if File B
   was not provided (Section 3).
4. **Summary sheet** -- the colour-coded breakdown and % breakdowns from Section 5,
   for EM always, and EL/Combined only when EL was computed, plus footnotes for
   anything excluded (voided/deleted-only encounters, unrecognised Admission
   Types, EL Point-of-Care exclusions, Missed FC source, Inflight exception
   counts) and a warning block listing any unrecognised FC Status values seen.
5. **Methodology sheet** -- a plain-language explanation of exactly which rule
   counted each encounter as completed/missed, with the actual numbers for this
   month, so every figure can be traced back to a rule.

---

## 7. Please Confirm

> **Status (2026-07-29):** all eight questions below were originally confirmed
> 2026-06-18. Q1 and Q3 were subsequently revisited against "Guide to monthly
> processing of report 3.docx" (the authoritative source, which this document
> had silently diverged from) and revised -- see the note at the top of this
> document. Their answers below have been updated to match the guide and the
> shipped code; Q2, Q4-Q8 stand as originally confirmed (Q2's priority *table*
> was separately revised for Decision 2 -- see Section 2 above -- but the
> ranking order itself is unchanged).

   the **Admission Type** field, with no other conditions (e.g. ward/Point Of
   Care)?~~ **REVISED:** no -- Elective Inpatient rows also require Point of
   Care to match the configured NCID ward E/F list (Section 2, step 9).

2. **FC Status priority order** (Section 2, step 3) -- is this the correct order of

3. **Inflight duplicate-resolution rule** (Section 2, step 6) -- ~~when an

4. **Voided/Deleted-only encounters** (Section 2, step 8) -- should these be fully

5. **EDVW discharges** (Section 3, step 3) -- should these continue to count as

6. **Staff roster teams** (Section 4) -- are ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO,

input.old_string:
8. **Encounters where the only FC ID was Voided/Deleted (priority 99)** are removed
   from the count entirely (not counted as completed, not counted as missed). The
   tool reports how many of these there were, so staff can double-check whether an FC
   is still needed for those encounters.

9. **Split the remaining rows into two sheets, based on Admission Type AND
   (for Elective) Point of Care:**
   - **Emergency** admissions -> "EM" sheet.
   - **Elective Inpatient** admissions go to the "EL" sheet ONLY if their Point
     of Care is one of the configured NCID ward E/F values (a Config-sheet
     list, editable without touching code). This matters because without it,
     the EL denominator would be every elective inpatient admission
     hospital-wide, while the numerator is only NCID AO's own work.
   - Elective Inpatient rows whose Point of Care is NOT in that list are set
     aside and reported separately (not silently dropped) -- they go into
     neither EM nor EL.
   - If the NCID Point of Care list hasn't been filled in yet (ships empty),
     the tool does NOT guess: it skips the EL sheet and all EL statistics
     entirely, shows a warning, and says so clearly on the Summary and
     Methodology sheets. EM is still produced normally in that case.
   - Any row that is neither Emergency nor Elective Inpatient (shouldn't
     normally happen, given the export filters) is set aside and reported
     separately so nothing silently disappears.
   - As an extra check (informational only, doesn't change which sheet a row goes
     to), the tool flags rows where the bucket "looks wrong" -- e.g. an Emergency
     row that was actually closed by an NCID AO staff member, or an Elective row
     closed by ED/EDFC or Inflight staff. This is just a flag for staff to review.

input.old_string:
- **NCID EL Point of Care** -- the exact Point of Care ward text values (NCID
  wards E and F) that gate the EL split (Step 9 above). Ships empty; must be
  filled in from a real export before EL statistics will be computed.

---
input.new_string:
- **NCID EL Point of Care** -- the exact Point of Care ward text values (NCID
  wards E and F). **REVISED 2026-07-30:** no longer gates the EL split (Step 9
  above) -- purely informational (the "NCID Ward" column/sub-block and the
  unmatched-value warning). Ships prefilled with the 10 confirmed ward values,
  still user-editable.

Because the staff roster gates team attribution, the Inflight duplicate
exception, and the "who closed the CCF" breakdown all at once, an empty or
badly-matched roster used to fail silently (everyone defaults to "Others",
and the report just shows 100% "Others" with no error). As of 2026-07-30 the
tool runs a **roster coverage guard** right after File A cleaning: it
measures what fraction of encounters map to a named team.
- **0% coverage:** asks whether to continue with completion statistics only
  (team attribution and the numerator table are suppressed entirely, not
  shown as rows of zeros) or abort.
- **Under 70%:** proceeds, but lists the unmatched staff names (biggest first)
  on the Summary sheet so you know which names to add.
- **70% or above:** proceeds silently; unmatched names are still listed on the
  Staff Roster Check sheet.

Three Alt+F8 tools help keep the roster populated and portable across the
report's monthly hand-off between team leads:
- **SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare** -- bootstraps a starting roster from an FC
  Summary Report export, guessing each staff member's team from their
  dominant Point of Care. Never overwrites a team you've already entered;
  low-confidence guesses (dominant Point of Care under 50%) are flagged.
- **ExportStaffRoster / ImportStaffRoster** -- round-trips the roster through
  a CSV file.

---

input.old_string:
**Denominator** (total encounters counted) = (encounters kept after File A
deduplication, excluding voided/deleted-only, priority 99) + (genuinely missed
FC count, from File B or manual entry -- Section 3).

**A. Completion status breakdown** (counts and % of denominator) -- five bands,
plus a "Not completed (total)" subtotal so the old single headline figure is
still available:

| Colour | Meaning | Based on priority |
|---|---|---|
| Green | FC Completed with written acknowledgement | 1, 2 |
| Pink | CCF explained but not signed | 3 |
| Light Green | Attempted, no further follow-up | 4, 5 |
| Orange | FC not completed | 6 |
| White/none | Draft only -- no FC outcome | 98 |
| Grey | Missed FC -- no FC ID created | File B / manual entry |

"Not completed (total)" = Orange + White/none + Grey. Splitting Drafts
(priority 98) into their own band does not change this total or the overall
completion percentage -- only the presentation. Each Summary block also shows
a visible "Total" row so a mismatch between the bands and the denominator
would be obvious.

content.content:
40	
41	Two files selected via the FilePickerForm dashboard:
42	
43	### File A -- FC Summary Report
44	- **Source**: eFC -> FC Summary Report function
45	- **Filters on export**: full month date range, Admission Type = Emergency (+ Elective Inpatient for NCID AO)
46	- **Header row**: Row 1
47	- **Sheet**: confirm from actual export (typically Sheet1)
48	- **Key columns** (confirm letters from a real export -- do NOT hardcode positions):
49	  - FC ID, Encounter Number (col C confirmed), FC Mode, FC Status (col F confirmed), FC Created By, FC Created On, FC Last Updated By, FC Last Updated On, Admission Date, Admission Type, Admission Status, 1st CCF ETBS, Latest CCF Creation User, Point of Care
50	- **Validation**: check for FC ID, Encounter Number, FC Status, FC Mode columns
51	
52	### File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report (OPTIONAL, 2026-07-29)
53	- **Source**: eFC -> Inflight FC Report, with Missed FC indicator ticked
54	- If not provided, the FilePickerForm asks for a manual "Missed FC count (dashboard workaround)" number instead (default 0), attributed entirely to Emergency (EM) in the output
55	- **Header row**: Row 1
56	- **Sheet**: confirm from actual export (typically Sheet1)
57	- **Key columns** (standard Inflight FC Report format, A-AW):
58	  - Encounter No -> col C (text, e.g. `100241111111`)
59	  - Admission Status -> col I (values: Actualised, Planned, Cancelled, Discharged)
60	  - Missed FC -> col AO (value: "Yes" or blank)
61	  - Admission Type -> col G
62	  - FC Mode -> confirm column (may not exist in Inflight FC Report format; verify)
63	- **Validation**: check for Encounter No, Missed FC, Admission Status columns
64	- **Workaround flag**: if Missed FC column is entirely blank, warn the user and prompt them to use the manual eFC dashboard workaround export instead
65	
66	---
67	
68	## Processing Logic
69	
70	### File A workflow (in order)
71	
72	**Step 1 -- Filter FC Mode.**
73	Delete rows where FC Mode is not `"Financial Counselling - AH"` or `"Financial Counselling - Downtime"`. This removes Shopper mode and any other non-relevant modes.
74	
75	**Step 2 -- Delete Cancelled Admissions.**
76	Delete rows where Admission Status = `"Cancelled"`.
77	
78	**Step 3 -- Sort.**
79	Sort ascending by: (1) Latest CCF Creation Date-Time, then (2) Encounter Number. This ensures the latest FC ID appears at the bottom of each encounter group.
80	
81	**Step 4 -- Highlight Duplicate Encounter Numbers.**
82	Apply red fill to all cells in the Encounter Number column that are duplicates (i.e. appear more than once). This is a visual aid -- staff review duplicates manually.
83	
84	**Step 5 -- Add PRIORITISE column.**
85	Insert a new column (header: `"PRIORITISE"`) immediately after the last data column. Populate with a priority score per FC Status value. The priority order (lowest number = highest priority = row to keep):
86	
87	| Priority | FC Status |
88	|----------|-----------|
89	| 1 | Completed |
90	| 2 | Acknowledgement by other means |
91	| 3 | Attempted - Virtual FC Completed, pending signature |
92	| 4 | Attempted - patient/NOK declines to sign |
93	| 5 | Attempted - Patient is unable to sign |
94	| 6 | Attempted - unable to complete |
95	| 98 | Draft / other -- anything not explicitly listed above (blank, typo, new eFC status). Still IN the denominator, counted as not completed. |
96	| 99 | Voided / Deleted ONLY (matched by substring, e.g. "Voided", "Deleted by Admin") -- excluded from denominator entirely |
97	
98	**Step 6 -- Add deduplication flag column.**
99	Insert a column (header: `"YES for Unique + highest Priority"`). For each row, flag `"YES"` if it is the single row to retain for that Encounter Number: the row with the lowest priority score. If two FC IDs share the same priority, retain the one with the largest (latest) FC ID. All other rows for that encounter get blank.
100	
101	**Step 7 -- Mass delete obvious duplicates.**
102	Delete in bulk all rows meeting ALL three conditions simultaneously:
103	- The encounter number is a duplicate (red-highlighted)
104	- At least one other row for that encounter has FC Status = `"Completed"` or `"Acknowledgement by other means"`
105	- The current row's FC Status is neither `"Completed"` nor `"Acknowledgement by other means"`
106	
107	**Step 8 -- Flag remaining duplicates for manual review.**
108	After mass deletion, the remaining duplicate encounter rows are surfaced to the user. The macro should display the count and ask the user to review them manually (or provide a helper to step through them). The deduplication flag column (Step 6) guides which to delete.
109	
110	**Step 9 -- Exception: Inflight-created duplicates (narrowed 2026-07-29).**
111	During deduplication, the default rule is plain lowest-priority-wins (tie-break: larger FC ID). The Inflight exception only overrides this when BOTH hold: (a) a non-Inflight candidate in the group was created by an ED/EDFC staff member, AND (b) the winner picked from the non-Inflight candidates has priority <= 2 (Completed / Acknowledgement by other means). If either fails, the plain rule stands and the Inflight row is treated like any other candidate. This prevents EDFC workload from being undercounted without over-applying the exception to cases where it doesn't clearly help.
112	
113	Staff names / identifiers for Inflight team in FC Created By: **[TO BE FILLED BY USER]**
114	
115	**Step 10 -- Separate EM and EL admissions.**
116	Use Admission Type column to split rows into:
117	- Emergency (EM) -- handled by EDFC, Inflight, and NCID AO
118	- Elective Inpatient (EL) for NCID AO only -- filter by Point of Care matching NCID ward E or F values (Config sheet "NCID EL Point of Care" list; if empty, EL is skipped entirely and EM is still produced)
119	
120	### File B workflow (in order)
121	
122	**Step 1 -- Filter FC Mode** (if column exists).
123	Delete rows where FC Mode = Shopper or any non-FC mode.
124	
125	**Step 2 -- Delete Cancelled and Planned Admissions.**
126	Delete rows where Admission Status = `"Cancelled"` or `"Planned"`. (Cancelled = upstream cancellation; Planned = patient never actualised in ward.)
127	
128	**Step 3 -- EDVW discharge handling.**
129	Patients discharged from EDVW may be short-stay cases not covered by EDFC (e.g. Hand Surgery, Ortho, General Surgery). **[TO BE CONFIRMED: auto-exclude or flag for manual review?]**
130	
131	**Step 4 -- Retain missed FC CSNs.**
132	Remaining rows after cleaning = genuinely missed FC cases. Count is added to the denominator.
133	
134	---
135	
136	## Denominator and Numerator
137	
138	**Denominator** = unique encounter count from cleaned File A (excluding Voided/Deleted FC IDs, priority 99) + missed FC CSN count (from cleaned File B, or the manual dashboard-workaround entry if File B was not provided).
139
